\"E_90001_Clip12_159\".m_mContent: "You seem rather chummy with that grand alchemist, but I won't tolerate any experiments on my ship!"

\"E_90001_Clip12_160\".m_mContent: "Don't mind William—he always talks like that. But deep down, he's thrilled. Isn't that right?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_164\".m_mContent: "Whatever! Just don't treat my ship like a snack, that's all I ask!"

\"E_90001_Clip12_165\".m_mContent: "Excuse me... I'm still the captain here, aren't I?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_166\".m_mContent: "Sounds like we're in for a rather... turbulent voyage. What do you think, Regina?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_167\".m_mContent: "Ah, Asta... what a city. Despite the chaos yesterday, the festival's already back in full swing."

\"E_90001_Clip12_168\".m_mContent: "These fireworks... if only Stella could see them too."

\"E_90001_Clip12_170\".m_mContent: "You still haven't told us what really happened over there!"

\"E_90001_Clip12_171\".m_mContent: "I believe what Noah meant is this: To us, it was but one night. To them… it was long enough to cross into a new era."

\"E_90001_Clip12_172\".m_mContent: "Hurry up! They're about to light the bonfire!"

\"E_90001_Clip12_173\".m_mContent: "I heard anyone nearby might get picked to help!"

\"E_90001_Clip12_174\".m_mContent: "Hey! Dumb wolf! Who said you could run off on your own?!"

\"E_90001_Clip12_175\".m_mContent: "...Thank you, Aiona. Come, let's join them—"

\"E_90001_Clip12_177\".m_mContent: "Heh... Now this is a fascinating entry."

\"E_90001_Clip12_178\".m_mContent: "Your laughter echoes all the way out here."

\"E_90001_Clip12_179\".m_mContent: "Have you discovered a way to resist the Long Night?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_180\".m_mContent: "Not quite. But I did come across a rather curious tale. I think you'll find it most intriguing."

\"E_90001_Clip12_181\".m_mContent: "That strange construct with the bottles... Was that what you thought I might find intriguing?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_182\".m_mContent: "Each of those bottles holds a world entire."

\"E_90001_Clip12_183\".m_mContent: "And in every world... a story waiting to be told."

\"E_100001_Clip00_002\".m_mContent: "My last memory... is the Blood Moon above, a man's whispered words about "returning to the home," and familiar faces fading into darkness..."

\"E_100001_Clip00_003\".m_mContent: "Then came darkness—endless, all-consuming darkness, devouring me into the void..."

\"E_100001_Clip00_005\".m_mContent: "What was that sound... the sound of a carriage?"

\"E_100001_Clip01_001\".m_mContent: "This place again... Who have I become this time?"

\"E_100001_Clip01_002\".m_mContent: "No... This time it's really me, and I've... truly returned?"

\"E_100001_Clip01_003\".m_mContent: "I can only say, I'm sorry, truly..."

\"E_100001_Clip01_004\".m_mContent: "So this is how we meet again in this place."

\"E_100001_Clip01_007\".m_mContent: "I wouldn't bother if I were you."

\"E_100001_Clip01_009\".m_mContent: "I can only say, I'm sorry, truly..."

\"E_100001_Clip01_010\".m_mContent: "If you have known this was a cycle, have you never sought to break it?"

\"E_100001_Clip01_011\".m_mContent: "Even after so many turns, you yield not an inch. Your obstinacy… remains admirably steadfast."

\"E_100001_Clip01_014\".m_mContent: "(Coughing) Each reunion comes swifter than the last."

\"E_100001_Clip01_015\".m_mContent: "How many cycles have passed us by? I have long since lost the tally."

\"E_100001_Clip01_016\".m_mContent: "I wonder, what is it that drives you still? Time and again you struggle in vain, only to be cast back into this carriage."

\"E_100001_Clip01_017\".m_mContent: "You and I are not so different. We both carry unfinished burdens. Yet you… have let 'truth' bind your hands and fetter your stride."

\"E_100001_Clip01_018\".m_mContent: "Oh? And what stratagem will you conjure this time?"

\"E_100001_Clip01_020\".m_mContent: "Of countless fates, every one casts us as foes."

\"E_100001_Clip01_021\".m_mContent: "Yet none would dream… that we might stand as one."

\"E_100001_Clip01_022\".m_mContent: "Sounds like trouble all over again… but I suppose it could be tried."

\"E_100001_Clip01_023\".m_mContent: "Hmm… I must say, you're the fairest of all who have come this month."

\"E_100001_Clip01_025\".m_mContent: "That's Genevieve—one of the most treacherous souls in the Ironfist Gaol."

\"E_100001_Clip01_026\".m_mContent: "She preys upon clever yet desperate captives such as yourself, using them as mere stepping stones to secure her own escape."

\"E_100001_Clip01_027\".m_mContent: "Everyone here seeks a way to flee. Are you truly the only one who does not?"

\"E_100001_Clip01_028\".m_mContent: "You do not understand… none can leave. This is the end."

\"E_100001_Clip01_029\".m_mContent: "Ugh... my head hurts so much. Everything's pitch black around me. Did I fail again?"

\"E_100001_Clip01_031\".m_mContent: "Silence encloses me. The seat beneath feels firm and steady—no sway, no jolt of carriage wheels. We are indoors."

\"E_100001_Clip01_032\".m_mContent: "Stone walls hem me in. Beneath me lies but a threadbare blanket—a poor man’s bedding. The air is thick with the metallic tang of rust…"

\"E_100001_Clip01_034\".m_mContent: "Chains rattle… the stench of rust and decay clings to the air. Another prison, then."

\"E_100001_Clip01_035\".m_mContent: "There is good news: my accord with Agares bore fruit—I am free of that endless cycle of nightmare."

\"E_100001_Clip01_036\".m_mContent: "But the truth remains bitter: I do not know where I am, why I am confined… nor how I might find the others again."

\"E_100001_Clip01_037\".m_mContent: "For now, I must turn my thoughts to escape. Only then may I seek the answers I need."

\"E_100001_Clip01_039\".m_mContent: "A common warding lock. Mere child's play beside the intricate devices that guard the dungeons of Bathory."

\"E_100001_Clip01_040\".m_mContent: "The lock yields swiftly to his hand, yet its defeat rouses some unseen alarm."

\"E_100001_Clip01_042\".m_mContent: "Never have I seen a new prisoner so unruly—on your very first day, you not only attempt escape, but dare raise your hand against my jailers."

\"E_100001_Clip01_043\".m_mContent: "Hmm… a shattered lock? Then I stand corrected—this was no attempted escape, but a successful one."

\"E_100001_Clip01_044\".m_mContent: "Most impressive. Now… let us see what strength remains once my shackles have claimed you."

\"E_100001_Clip01_045\".m_mContent: "Ugh… You—what are you? How can you shackle me from such distance?"

\"E_100001_Clip01_046\".m_mContent: "Fanny. Though you will address me as Warden."

\"E_100001_Clip01_047\".m_mContent: "Hmm… I must say, you're the fairest of all who have come this month."

\"E_100001_Clip01_048\".m_mContent: "Soft silver hair, skin so fair, lips the shade of blood… you were made to be torture's cherished plaything. I can hardly wait to watch that fair form split and bleed."

\"E_100001_Clip01_049\".m_mContent: "A black cloth is wrenched over Noah's eyes, still warm to the touch. Clearly, he is not the first to grace this chamber tonight."

\"E_100001_Clip01_050\".m_mContent: "Quiet—some of us still seek what little rest this pit allows."
\"E_100001_Clip01_050\".m_RoleName: "隔壁牢狱传来的女声（耶芙娜）"

\"E_100001_Clip01_051\".m_mContent: "Patience, red-haired sinner. Your turn shall come."

\"E_100001_Clip01_052\".m_mContent: "This is a prison, not your playground. Show some restraint, or we'll have another demon like you on our hands."
\"E_100001_Clip01_052\".m_RoleName: "隔壁牢狱传来的女声（耶芙娜）"

\"E_100001_Clip01_054\".m_mContent: "Her pride stung, Fanny lashed out, boot cracking against the iron bars of the neighboring cell."

\"E_100001_Clip01_055\".m_mContent: "How does it feel kneeling there with your hands bound behind your back?"

\"E_100001_Clip01_056\".m_mContent: "Around your throat, a silver fork, its ends fused as one. One tine already lodged beneath your jaw… the other buried deep in your collarbone."

\"E_100001_Clip01_057\".m_mContent: "Speak one lie and a gentle stroke on your head will have these forked points pierce your tender flesh and bleed you crimson."

\"E_100001_Clip01_058\".m_mContent: "By Aeon's name, repent at once. State your name."

\"E_100001_Clip01_061\".m_mContent: "Before this… I practiced medicine in a small town."

\"E_100001_Clip01_063\".m_mContent: "Spikes pierced flesh, and agony surged over him like a tide."

\"E_100001_Clip01_064\".m_mContent: "You turned your back on the Tempus Church. You defected to the Black Blood. Across the continent you are hunted as the Silver-haired Heretic… Bearing sins so grave—why do you not confess?!"

\"E_100001_Clip01_065\".m_mContent: "Redemption lies between the soul and the divine. It requires no mortal hand."

\"E_100001_Clip01_066\".m_mContent: "The Codex Sanctus , Chapter Seven, declares: 'All who forsake the light and cast themselves into darkness shall suffer eternal torment.'"

\"E_100001_Clip01_067\".m_mContent: "Interesting. When you speak of the divine, your eyes are vacant—like lines recited from another's script."

\"E_100001_Clip01_068\".m_mContent: "Another lance of pain tore through his chest—yet the hand that delivered it trembled."

\"E_100001_Clip01_069\".m_mContent: "You are nothing but a wretch, veins tainted with Black Blood. What wisdom could you possibly possess?"

\"E_100001_Clip01_070\".m_mContent: "Enough to know this: your reaction when that woman struck your nerve."

\"E_100001_Clip01_071\".m_mContent: "She said, 'another demon like you.' The words—like you—are what enraged you, not being called a 'demon.'"

\"E_100001_Clip01_072\".m_mContent: "Born of criminals, raised in chains, never once living a life of your own—what faith, what will could such a being truly possess? You are nothing but an empty shell."

\"E_100001_Clip01_073\".m_mContent: "At least I know my sins are mine, my choices carved by my own hand. But you… even your so-called devotion is not your own."

\"E_100001_Clip01_074\".m_mContent: "You are the one who is truly imprisoned."

\"E_100001_Clip01_076\".m_mContent: "You dare—you dare defy me so brazenly! What an… intriguing prisoner you are."

\"E_100001_Clip01_077\".m_mContent: "Let me look at you more closely… conspiring with Bathory, setting the plague loose upon the Lupine Forest, sending the El Dorado to the depths, letting Sunset Isle burn, watching Starfall Valley collapse into ruin…"

\"E_100001_Clip01_078\".m_mContent: "Ah, yes. A soul woven of calamity. Truly… you fascinate me more with every breath."

\"E_100001_Clip02_001\".m_mContent: "Yard time's thirty minutes—no more! Keep still, keep quiet! You know well enough what the Warden does to those who step out of line!"

\"E_100001_Clip02_002\".m_mContent: "And you—fresh off the cart and already trying to bolt! Fasten those shackles tight!"

\"E_100001_Clip02_003\".m_mContent: "(So this is the recreation yard. By all logic, it should be rife with schemes of escape… yet the guards are few. Why?)"

\"E_100001_Clip02_004\".m_mContent: "Seeking the way out? This may not be that mad Fanny's ward, yet Aeon's gaze is everywhere. Do not think escape so easily won."

\"E_100001_Clip02_005\".m_mContent: "This is a prison, not your playground. Show some restraint, or we'll have another demon like you on our hands."
\"E_100001_Clip02_005\".m_RoleName: "隔壁牢狱传来的女声（耶芙娜）"

\"E_100001_Clip02_006\".m_mContent: "You are the one in the neighboring cell. Last night, you exposed Fanny's weakness on purpose."

\"E_100001_Clip02_007\".m_mContent: "You likely do not know my name. I am Genevieve."

\"E_100001_Clip02_008\".m_mContent: "Naturally I would not know—we have never met."

\"E_100001_Clip02_009\".m_mContent: "But I know you—or rather, I know you well. Noah, it is good to see you again."

\"E_100001_Clip02_010\".m_mContent: "I know you question my every word, my every action... All the same, my purpose is clear: to see you free of this place."

\"E_100001_Clip02_011\".m_mContent: "Last night's little hint served well. We must remain here a while longer, and sparing you needless torment is my duty."

\"E_100001_Clip02_012\".m_mContent: "And, perhaps, my own intent as well… You have felt it already—Fanny's methods are beneath all dignity."

\"E_100001_Clip02_013\".m_mContent: "Prison rags upon my back, shackles at my ankles… I hardly expect to find much dignity in a place like this."

\"E_100001_Clip02_014\".m_mContent: "Are you being grateful? Or do you actually enjoy this?"

\"E_100001_Clip02_015\".m_mContent: "Ah, yes—I nearly forgot. You are the man purified by holy flame upon the pyre, countless times. To you, ordinary pain must serve as nothing more than a needle prick."

\"E_100001_Clip02_016\".m_mContent: "Before you rush to prove how well you know me, ought you not explain those figures in the shadows, northeast corner?"

\"E_100001_Clip02_017\".m_mContent: "They've been watching us since we sat down."

\"E_100001_Clip02_018\".m_mContent: "They are mine. Easy now—you glare too sharply, and you will soon be marked as troublemakers."

\"E_100001_Clip02_019\".m_mContent: "But enough. It is time you saw the true enemy barring your escape. Sight alone convinces. Henry, sound the alarm."

\"E_100001_Clip02_021\".m_mContent: "ALERT—Ironfist Gaol has suffered a sudden breach—deploy all defenses at once."

\"E_100001_Clip02_022\".m_mContent: "Which fool sounded that alarm? Do you all have a death wish? Yard time is over. Crawl back into your cages. Now!"

\"E_100001_Clip02_023\".m_mContent: "Blindfolded figures are driven in single file into the prison's depths."

\"E_100001_Clip02_024\".m_mContent: "Those weapons that fell from the sky… they bore the Church's seal. So this truly is their ground."

\"E_100001_Clip02_025\".m_mContent: "Now you see. This is the Tempus Church's Ironfist Gaol, governed entirely by its 'laws' and 'weapons'."

\"E_100001_Clip02_026\".m_mContent: "Those confined here, for the most part, defied their ordained fate and were cast out by the Timeline itself. You labored so hard to shatter the cycle—this is the price such defiance demands."

\"E_100001_Clip02_027\".m_mContent: "The ones you saw earlier are my cultivated contacts here in the prison. They too turned against the Timeline, and so we formed an alliance of benefit. I provide what they seek, and they lend me their blades."

\"E_100001_Clip02_028\".m_mContent: "And Fanny—the Church's sanction of her as Warden proves she holds some peculiar value. That may be the key we can use to our advantage."

\"E_100001_Clip02_029\".m_mContent: "That was my thought as well. Her interrogation chamber must conceal truths about this prison."

\"E_100001_Clip02_030\".m_mContent: "Precisely. When she summons you to 'repent' tonight, there's one thing you must look out for."

\"E_100001_Clip02_031\".m_mContent: "You mean the locked oak cabinet behind the rack."

\"E_100001_Clip02_033\".m_mContent: "The rest of the room lies strewn with documents, drawers and cupboards left open—yet that cabinet alone is bound fast with double iron locks. Such excess speaks too loudly to be coincidence."

\"E_100001_Clip02_034\".m_mContent: "Whatever it conceals—even if not the Church's most guarded secret—must surely betray her weakness."

\"E_100001_Clip02_035\".m_mContent: "I know you won't waver, Noah. All the same, be cautious with that girl—her fixation on you is dangerous."

\"E_100001_Clip03_002\".m_mContent: "The opposite cell lay shrouded in silence. Noah's brow furrowed, and just as he drew breath to call again, familiar footsteps echoed through the corridor."

\"E_100001_Clip03_003\".m_mContent: "Awake in the dead of night, murmuring into the dark… who is it you whisper to?"

\"E_100001_Clip03_004\".m_mContent: "Mere insomnia, Warden. Surely even prisoners are allowed their nightmares."

\"E_100001_Clip03_005\".m_mContent: "Then share them with me. Last night's little confession was exquisite—I've been aching for more. Tonight, we continue."

\"E_100001_Clip03_006\".m_mContent: "The clash of iron rings through the air as Noah is bound once more. Yet this time, Fanny's hands tremble with fevered urgency."

\"E_100001_Clip03_007\".m_mContent: "You appear more eager than usual for this interrogation."

\"E_100001_Clip03_008\".m_mContent: "Eager? Oh, Noah—it is ecstasy. To see you slick with sweat, jaw clenched against agony, still forcing out those proud little words… mmm, nothing is sweeter."

\"E_100001_Clip03_009\".m_mContent: "Do you know what most become here? They break or sink into lifeless despair. But you… you study me."

\"E_100001_Clip03_010\".m_mContent: "Before you lose yourself, perhaps we should think on how to deal with them first."

\"E_100001_Clip03_010a\".m_mContent: "The very alarm Henry had 'accidentally' rung in the day now loomed before them, waiting for Noah's hand to set it tolling."

\"E_100001_Clip03_011\".m_mContent: "What—leaving me already? Do you think the same trick will work twice?!"

\"E_100001_Clip03_013\".m_mContent: "ALERT—Ironfist Gaol has suffered a sudden breach—deploy all defenses at once."

\"E_100001_Clip03_014\".m_mContent: "(Fanny's still busy with those Church weapons. Good. From here to the interrogation chamber: left to the corridor's end, then right.)"

\"E_100001_Clip03_015\".m_mContent: "(This is it—the place. The door isn't even locked… Her arrogance will be her undoing.)"

\"E_100001_Clip03_016\".m_mContent: "(The locked cabinet behind the rack of instruments—there it is.)"

\"E_100001_Clip03_017\".m_mContent: "(What is this… dozens of vials of blood, each a different shade, each marked with a name and date. She is no Bloodborn—so why hoard human blood? Unless…)"

\"E_100001_Clip03_019\".m_mContent: "Such obedience. You didn't even need my escort. You crept in here all on your own to wait for punishment?"

\"E_100001_Clip03_020\".m_mContent: "Didn't you wish to hear my nightmares, Warden? These cursed visions haunt me night after night. I'm ready to share them with you."

\"E_100001_Clip03_021\".m_mContent: "My, you sure know how to please me. Spin them well, and perhaps I'll let you live until dawn."

\"E_100001_Clip03_022\".m_mContent: "The first dream: a poet of humble birth, reborn in the twin flames of Eternal Fire and Holy Flame. He thought this new radiance would crown him the sun itself."

\"E_100001_Clip03_023\".m_mContent: "But at the peak he learned the truth—he was no sun, had never even brushed its light. He was but a vulture circling at the edge of dawn, destined to burn when true daybreak came."

\"E_100001_Clip03_024\".m_mContent: "You call that a nightmare? To be saved by faith's fire, to taste bliss upon the path to the sublime, and at last to ascend in holy brilliance, become one with the creator of all… That is a dream to be envied."

\"E_100001_Clip03_026\".m_mContent: "A puppetmaster longed to stage a deicide pantomime. He wrote his script and lured four pawns into the game."

\"E_100001_Clip03_027\".m_mContent: "Each pawn believed their choices were their own, yet their fate had been written the moment the first piece fell."

\"E_100001_Clip03_028\".m_mContent: "Still you call it a nightmare? Every mortal is bound to the same fate—clutching their script, playing their part, bowing to applause before vanishing behind the curtain. That is the fate of all living beings."

\"E_100001_Clip03_029\".m_mContent: "But this next dream… this one should satisfy me."

\"E_100001_Clip03_030\".m_mContent: "A fool perished in fire, then awoke in the cold embrace of a coffin. The world he met was at once familiar and strange. He remembered nothing but one vow—to return alive."

\"E_100001_Clip03_031\".m_mContent: "He clawed for his lost past, but memory slipped away like morning mist—the tighter his grasp, the quicker it vanished."

\"E_100001_Clip03_032\".m_mContent: "Are you mocking me because I too have no past?!"

\"E_100001_Clip03_033\".m_mContent: "No. I’m trying to understand you. That Fool was me once—I know how terrible that void is."

\"E_100001_Clip03_034\".m_mContent: "So I see through you as well. If faith were enough, you would not need to steal the memories of others."

\"E_100001_Clip03_036\".m_mContent: "The blood in that cabinet. You drink the prisoners' blood to glimpse their memories, to live their lives. Am I wrong?"

\"E_100001_Clip03_039\".m_mContent: "Why should I? You uncovered my secret, and the thought of it thrills me. Do you know how long it's been since anyone truly saw through me?"

\"E_100001_Clip03_040\".m_mContent: "Tonight's little dance has pleased me greatly. Here—take this. A personal invitation from the Warden. When the nightmares return, show it to the guards—they will deliver you straight to me."

\"E_100001_Clip03_041\".m_mContent: "But tell me before you leave… who led you to that cabinet? Was it the red-haired woman?"

\"E_100001_Clip03_043\".m_mContent: "That's Genevieve—one of the most treacherous souls in the Ironfist Gaol."

\"E_100001_Clip03_044\".m_mContent: "She preys on clever, desperate men like you. She tempts them with hope, then grinds them beneath her feet to pave her own escape."

\"E_100001_Clip03_045\".m_mContent: "She toys with others, using them to claw her way out—only to be dragged back, again and again. To her, it’s nothing but a game."

\"E_100001_Clip03_046\".m_mContent: "But you, Noah—you are a prisoner I will not lose. Stay away from her."

\"E_100001_Clip03_047\".m_mContent: "Then let me ask you—do you truly enjoy being Warden so much? Everyone here dreams of escape. Do you not?"

\"E_100001_Clip03_050\".m_mContent: "You do not understand… none can leave. This is the end."

\"E_100001_Clip04_001\".m_mContent: "Trouble yesterday means yard time's cut to twenty minutes! Move it—quick in, quick out, no dawdling!"

\"E_100001_Clip04_002\".m_mContent: "If I'm not mistaken, she waved that wanted poster last night—painting me as some irredeemable criminal."

\"E_100001_Clip04_003\".m_mContent: "For someone who claims she wasn't there, you seem remarkably well informed."

\"E_100001_Clip04_004\".m_mContent: "Her favorite trick. Whenever someone nears an inconvenient truth, that paper appears—right on cue."

\"E_100001_Clip04_005\".m_mContent: "Fanny? To me she looks more like a puppet shoved into the spotlight. All bluster masking impotence—grasping at what little validation she can among her toys of torment."

\"E_100001_Clip04_006\".m_mContent: "And what did you find in that cabinet to make you so sure?"

\"E_100001_Clip04_009\".m_mContent: "I simply don't make a habit of airing others' secrets."

\"E_100001_Clip04_010\".m_mContent: "This is your fault, isn't it?! Cutting down my yard time! Even chained, I could still pound you into the dirt!"

\"E_100001_Clip04_011\".m_mContent: "...Not a moment's respite in this wretched place. How tiresome."

\"E_100001_Clip04_012\".m_mContent: "Loath as I am to admit it... her effort to divide us may be working."

\"E_100001_Clip04_013\".m_mContent: "I mistrust both kindness without reason and cruelty without cause. This isn't about her—it's my principle."

\"E_100001_Clip04_014\".m_mContent: "Noah, I know your nature. You won't trust easily, no matter what I say. And that's exactly what she's counting on."

\"E_100001_Clip04_015\".m_mContent: "Still, I'll tell you what I know. Only you can decide if it holds true."

\"E_100001_Clip04_016\".m_mContent: "For example: in one minute, this prison will be struck by a force strong enough to shake its very foundations. I call it 'The Comet's Fall'."

\"E_100001_Clip04_017\".m_mContent: "It comes at regular intervals. It is this prison's greatest weakness—and our best chance to escape."

\"E_100001_Clip04_018\".m_mContent: "When the moment comes, I only ask this: see with your own eyes, judge with your own heart. The choice will always be yours, Noah."

\"E_100001_Clip04_019\".m_mContent: "A deafening roar split the heavens, and the prison lurched as though the earth itself had bucked. The walls trembled, the ground convulsed, and prisoners ducked low, scattering for shelter."

\"E_100001_Clip04_022\".m_mContent: "Amidst the chaos, prisoners cowered in terror. Yet one figure stood apart—Fanny. At some unseen moment she had climbed to the heights of the yard, arms outstretched with an almost graceful poise toward the void."

\"E_100001_Clip04_023\".m_mContent: "Behold—the sacred chimes of Aeon's divine bells, a holy blessing poured upon the faithful!"

\"E_100001_Clip04_024\".m_mContent: "If this truly marks the prison's 'weakness', then why does the Warden greet it as though it were a grand festival?"

\"E_100001_Clip04_025\".m_mContent: "As I told you, she is far more than she seems."

\"E_100001_Clip04_026\".m_mContent: "Tell me—could a mere puppet stand so serene, even reveling in the moment, while a force threatens to tear this prison down to its foundations?"

\"E_100001_Clip04_027\".m_mContent: "You've only revealed the timing of our escape. Unless I'm gravely mistaken, you're still holding back the most vital pieces—our path and our destination."

\"E_100001_Clip04_028\".m_mContent: "And that is the greatest hindrance. The moment we step outside our cells, they bind our eyes with cloth."

\"E_100001_Clip04_029\".m_mContent: "I'd say they overestimate the value of sight."

\"E_100001_Clip05_001\".m_mContent: "Sharp, desperate knocks echoed through the wall—Genevieve's signal."

\"E_100001_Clip05_002\".m_mContent: "Fanny hasn't laid a hand on anyone for two days."

\"E_100001_Clip05_003\".m_mContent: "I heard the comet strike left several laborers gravely wounded—three died where they fell."

\"E_100001_Clip05_004\".m_mContent: "She's dealing with the aftermath now. We should wait, Noah. This is no time to provoke her."

\"E_100001_Clip05_005\".m_mContent: "No. This is the time. Fanny's anger is only a mask. The real her—"

\"E_100001_Clip05_006\".m_mContent: "Enough. I care nothing for the 'real' her."

\"E_100001_Clip05_007\".m_mContent: "Very well, do as you wish. You never heed my counsel anyway."

\"E_100001_Clip05_008\".m_mContent: "This is a personal invitation from the Warden herself. She's expecting me."

\"E_100001_Clip05_009\".m_mContent: "Put the blindfold on and follow me."

\"E_100001_Clip05_010\".m_mContent: "Hold it! The Warden is at prayer—no one disturbs her devotions!"

\"E_100001_Clip05_012\".m_mContent: "I said no! Back to your cell before I drag you there myself!"

\"E_100001_Clip05_013\".m_mContent: "In the stifling gloom, a scatter of candles cast their trembling light. Fanny knelt before the instruments of torment, her fingers gliding across them as if they were holy relics. Under her breath she whispered the names of the dead."

\"E_100001_Clip05_014\".m_mContent: "Marcus… behold your cherished instrument of torment. How many times have you cried your daughter's name beneath its bite? At last, you shall be reunited."

\"E_100001_Clip05_015\".m_mContent: "Sweet Alice… only fourteen. I always 'cherished' you as my little sister. Curse you—why did you run when the strike came? Was my lash too soft to teach you obedience?"

\"E_100001_Clip05_016\".m_mContent: "My apologies for disturbing your devotions, Warden."

\"E_100001_Clip05_017\".m_mContent: "How did you get in? There will be no interrogations tonight. I am… indisposed."

\"E_100001_Clip05_018\".m_mContent: "Because of those inmates who met their untimely end?"

\"E_100001_Clip05_019\".m_mContent: "Dead bodies have no place in prison! Do you understand the punishment I face for these runaways who dared to die?"

\"E_100001_Clip05_020\".m_mContent: "You're not tending their affairs—you're mourning them."

\"E_100001_Clip05_022\".m_mContent: "They may have been prisoners, but they were your only companions in this forsaken place."

\"E_100001_Clip05_023\".m_mContent: "As Warden, you were molded into Discipline itself—tormenting them was your sacred charge. But as a human soul, you hungered for connection, for warmth. Punishment became your only bridge to reach them."

\"E_100001_Clip05_024\".m_mContent: "Now they have abandoned you, and you taste the bitter draught of separation."

\"E_100001_Clip05_025\".m_mContent: "Pain cuts deeper than fleeting pleasure. You need no more punishments to fill that hollow within your soul."

\"E_100001_Clip05_026\".m_mContent: "This is what you have always longed for."

\"E_100001_Clip05_027\".m_mContent: "Have you come to gloat over my ruin? To see the mighty Warden toppled from her throne? Surely that is every prisoner's sweetest dream."

\"E_100001_Clip05_028\".m_mContent: "No. I've come to deliver deeper pain. True, unblemished pain."

\"E_100001_Clip05_031\".m_mContent: "Why are you cutting your own wrist? Are you punishing yourself—willingly?"

\"E_100001_Clip05_032\".m_mContent: "Isn't this what you've always done? In that cabinet—you stole their blood, their pasts… then used forbidden alchemy to wring ecstasy from memory."

\"E_100001_Clip05_033\".m_mContent: "Warden, I can give you what you crave."

\"E_100001_Clip05_034\".m_mContent: "The air grew thick with the sharp tang of blood, rich and intoxicating. Fanny's pupils dilated into dark pools as her knees buckled. Slowly she sank, her tongue trembling forward as though compelled by some primal, irresistible force."

\"E_100001_Clip05_036\".m_mContent: "In my 'execution grounds,' I command the 'ignition point' of all things..."

\"E_100001_Clip05_037\".m_mContent: "Ah, I almost forgot... You people of this era wouldn't know what an 'ignition point' is, would you? But know this..."

\"E_100001_Clip05_039\".m_mContent: "The life we shared… that quiet, ordinary time… It's a precious memory—one I'll carry always."

\"E_100001_Clip05_040\".m_mContent: "Is this truly the present you've chosen, Noah?"

\"E_100001_Clip05_041\".m_mContent: "...You still haven't answered me, Noah. If I disappear, would you remember me?"

\"E_100001_Clip05_043\".m_mContent: "What have you done to everyone?! Ressa, Aiona, and Empousa!"

\"E_100001_Clip05_044\".m_mContent: "At long last, it's time to awaken you, my first and final... the dream of 'returning home to the moon.'"

\"E_100001_Clip05_045\".m_mContent: "What… what is all of this? Are these… fragments of your past?"

\"E_100001_Clip05_046\".m_mContent: "They are proof that I once lived."

\"E_100001_Clip05_047\".m_mContent: "So this is what it means to live… Not breath, not a heartbeat, but this—this shuddering blaze that sets my soul aflame."

\"E_100001_Clip05_050\".m_mContent: "Where did you go? Don't... don't leave me behind."

\"E_100001_Clip05_051\".m_mContent: "The drawer... why is it open? A map of the prison… I knew it. You still mean to escape."

\"E_100001_Clip05_052\".m_mContent: "But what becomes of me if you leave? Return to that hollow world, pretend everything is fine? No. You cannot abandon me—"

\"E_100001_Clip06_001\".m_mContent: "Listen up! Twenty minutes of yard time—no more! The Warden's in a foul mood, so if any of you maggots step out of line, you'll get a taste of my baton!"

\"E_100001_Clip06_002\".m_mContent: "Fanny has her eyes on me. Her informants lurk in every shadow. We can't risk passing intelligence like this any longer."

\"E_100001_Clip06_004\".m_mContent: "Genevieve, listen well. In her chamber I found a full map of this prison—I've committed it to memory."

\"E_100001_Clip06_005\".m_mContent: "It's a three-tier complex below ground. This yard lies on the first level, alongside the guards' quarters and Fanny's interrogation hall."

\"E_100001_Clip06_006\".m_mContent: "If I'm right, the exit is at the far end of this floor."

\"E_100001_Clip06_007\".m_mContent: "The other two levels hold only cells. From the stairwells we climb for the yard time and questioning, I'd place our cells on the third basement."

\"E_100001_Clip06_008\".m_mContent: "It seems your 'comfort work' with the Warden last night proved profitable."

\"E_100001_Clip06_009\".m_mContent: "Save the wit for the day we're free. Fanny could summon me at any moment. Describe those three informants quickly."

\"E_100001_Clip06_010\".m_mContent: "I'll work out our position from their cells."

\"E_100001_Clip06_011\".m_mContent: "Henry wears a white hood. He often serves as our vanguard. Fond of chatting through the bars, punished for it often—but it's how he gathers information."

\"E_100001_Clip06_012\".m_mContent: "Jones wears gray armor. He was imprisoned for exposing the Church's darkest secrets. Always clutching scripture, he's become the Warden's most trusted prisoner—which grants him unusual freedom."

\"E_100001_Clip06_013\".m_mContent: "Skoll, in monk's robes, was a famed herbalist in his Timeline, locked here for brewing forbidden compounds. Any herbs I acquire, I pass to him for refinement. And also—"

\"E_100001_Clip06_015\".m_mContent: "Yard time's over. Back to your cells—now."

\"E_100001_Clip06_016\".m_mContent: "Twenty minutes of yard time… Even beasts get better treatment than us. I will not return."

\"E_100001_Clip06_017\".m_mContent: "You again! Looking to get yourself killed?!"

\"E_100001_Clip06_019\".m_mContent: "No need—I'm here. What is it, my favorite prisoner?"

\"E_100001_Clip06_020\".m_mContent: "W-What?! Warden—when did you… how did you get behind us?!"

\"E_100001_Clip06_021\".m_mContent: "The interrogation isn't until tonight. Why the sudden urgency? Or perhaps… you're planning another theft from my chambers?"

\"E_100001_Clip06_022\".m_mContent: "Last night told me much. Show me your world—your daily life, and the tale of how you came to wear the warden's mantle."

\"E_100001_Clip06_023\".m_mContent: "I see through your little schemes. But it matters little—from tonight onward, I'll share your cell through every dark hour. As for the interrogations, I'll entrust them to others."

\"E_100001_Clip06_024\".m_mContent: "Come—put on your blindfold. I warn you, though… my life is far less captivating than you imagine."

\"E_100001_Clip06_025\".m_mContent: "Let me properly introduce you to Ironfist Gaol—my nightly domain of toil. Each evening I walk these corridors, checking on every soul within these walls."

\"E_100001_Clip06_026\".m_mContent: "Verify they’re still breathing, note any irregularities, replace broken shackles. The routine takes about two hours."

\"E_100001_Clip06_027\".m_mContent: "(Left from the yard. Straight for fifty-six steps to the stairwell. Down one flight—second level.)"

\"E_100001_Clip06_028\".m_mContent: "This wing holds the worst of them—the truly dangerous. They could riot without warning. Yet curiously, it’s the quietest place in the prison."

\"E_100001_Clip06_029\".m_mContent: "Despair, most likely. When hope dies, so does the will to fight. What remains is waiting for... death."

\"E_100001_Clip06_030\".m_mContent: "(Herbal incense… unmistakable. Skoll's cell. Location confirmed.)"

\"E_100001_Clip06_031\".m_mContent: "Great Aeon, forgive my transgression—revealing forbidden truths, daring to question your might…"

\"E_100001_Clip06_032\".m_mContent: "(Thirty paces in, prayer resounds through the dark. Jones. That leaves only Henry.)"

\"E_100001_Clip06_033\".m_mContent: "This cell belongs to Thomas—a father condemned for forging coins to save his dying daughter. Every night at three, his weeping begins, lasting twenty minutes before silence returns until dawn. I've listened to his cries for seven years."

\"E_100001_Clip06_034\".m_mContent: "Sometimes I wonder—if the weeping ceased, would I even sleep? That sound… it has woven itself into my very being."

\"E_100001_Clip06_035\".m_mContent: "(Down the left passage—third level, the deepest circle. Still no sign of Henry.)"

\"E_100001_Clip06_036\".m_mContent: "Warden. Aren't you being too soft on that silver-haired? Evening strolls with him!"

\"E_100001_Clip06_037\".m_mContent: "(...Just as Genevieve said—a chatterbox. Perfect. All three positions confirmed.)"

\"E_100001_Clip06_038\".m_mContent: "So there it is—my life, laid bare. What do you make of it, my favorite prisoner? Hmm? What's with the silence? You're not one to startle so easily."

\"E_100001_Clip06_039\".m_mContent: "I was only wondering—if you've suspected me all along, why share so much?"

\"E_100001_Clip06_040\".m_mContent: "Because you are the first soul who's ever cared to glimpse into my world. Even if your intent runs deeper, even if this is but another step in your escape…"

\"E_100001_Clip06_041\".m_mContent: "At least, for this moment, I no longer stand alone before the endless dark."

\"E_100001_Clip07_001\".m_mContent: "Tonight feels different—quieter, less chaotic than usual."

\"E_100001_Clip07_002\".m_mContent: "Genevieve's voice drifted over, but Noah lacked the strength to focus. Tonight, the cell seemed to harbor an unexpected guest."

\"E_100001_Clip07_003\".m_mContent: "The comet strike... Most are likely buckling beneath its weight."

\"E_100001_Clip07_004\".m_mContent: "Warm breath ghosted across his knees, then trailed upward, leaving a faint, tingling sensation in its wake."

\"E_100001_Clip07_005\".m_mContent: "Is it the same for you? When you first felt the tremors, you seemed far more composed than you do now."

\"E_100001_Clip07_006\".m_mContent: "What haunts me is not the comet itself, but the ruin it leaves behind—ugh… argh…!"

\"E_100001_Clip07_007\".m_mContent: "With each thunderous impact, this place sinks into a silent frenzy. No voices raised, yet every soul straining to 'hear' everything."

\"E_100001_Clip07_008\".m_mContent: "As if responding to Noah's words, the intruder stirred restlessly, nudging with its nose before giving the tender flesh a gentle bite."

\"E_100001_Clip07_010\".m_mContent: "Perhaps the souls trapped here have long counted the comet among their few diversions."

\"E_100001_Clip07_011\".m_mContent: "But for you... it doesn't seem that way."

\"E_100001_Clip07_012\".m_mContent: "I was merely daydreaming—as I always do—of the mischief that might follow when the comet shatters this gaol."

\"E_100001_Clip07_013\".m_mContent: "I see… This must be the 'mischief' you said you were waiting for."

\"E_100001_Clip07_014\".m_mContent: "I thought we were of one mind. But hearing your tone…"

\"E_100001_Clip07_015\".m_mContent: "It sounds as if you harbor something even more 'interesting.'"

\"E_100001_Clip07_016\".m_mContent: "Something interesting? My dear prisoner, does that crimson-haired woman speak of me?"

\"E_100001_Clip07_017\".m_mContent: "The uninvited guest, head long nestled between his thighs, finally lifted glistening eyes."

\"E_100001_Clip07_018\".m_mContent: "Time to inspect the cells and ready Ironfist Gaol for the comet's approach, my Warden."

\"E_100001_Clip07_019\".m_mContent: "Such trifles hold no meaning now. What I want... Will you grant me another drop of your blood, my captive?"

\"E_100001_Clip07_020\".m_mContent: "Never did I imagine such rapture could flow from another's memories. One taste was all it took to make me hunger for more."

\"E_100001_Clip07_021\".m_mContent: "I never thought a mere glimpse into that hollow, tormented past could so utterly ensnare the Warden."

\"E_100001_Clip07_022\".m_mContent: "All living things recoil from Death by instinct. Rarely have I met a soul that reaches for Death's embrace as willingly as you."

\"E_100001_Clip07_023\".m_mContent: "May I take those words as your promise to me?"

\"E_100001_Clip07_026\".m_mContent: "Then it's time we take our leave."

\"E_100001_Clip07_030\".m_mContent: "Looking for me? Well, it seems I must claim your past once the comet has settled. Until then… do take care that nothing unfortunate befalls you."

\"E_100001_Clip07_031\".m_mContent: "I warned you—running through these halls carries consequences."

\"E_100001_Clip07_032\".m_mContent: "F-Forgive me! But the collision is imminent—we need you!"

\"E_100001_Clip07_034\".m_mContent: "So that's why you kept me from your plan."

\"E_100001_Clip07_035\".m_mContent: "She was waiting in my cell when we returned, as if she already knew what we're planning."

\"E_100001_Clip07_037\".m_mContent: "That voice... isn't that the same jailer who came looking for Fanny?"

\"E_100001_Clip07_038\".m_mContent: "Warden Fanny ordered you to stay put."

\"E_100001_Clip07_039\".m_mContent: "We'll keep watch until the impact ends, so don't try anything."

\"E_100001_Clip07_040\".m_mContent: "Sorry, but that's not your call to make—"

\"E_100001_Clip07_042\".m_mContent: "No key on him. Fanny meant for them to sit here and keep watch over me until the comet's strike has passed."

\"E_100001_Clip07_043\".m_mContent: "I warned you from the start—her obsession with you has gone far beyond what any Warden should show."

\"E_100001_Clip07_044\".m_mContent: "Perhaps it's the memories in my blood that drew her curiosity."

\"E_100001_Clip07_045\".m_mContent: "And that is the problem. The moment the comet's impact ends, she'll send someone for you at once."

\"E_100001_Clip07_046\".m_mContent: "But something's wrong. She knows your past—your memories. She knows better than anyone these jailers could never hold you."

\"E_100001_Clip07_047\".m_mContent: "Because she knows that even if we reach the gates of Ironfist Gaol, she has ways to make certain we never leave."

\"E_100001_Clip07_049\".m_mContent: "—Or perhaps something else lurks beyond these walls, something that will keep us from ever truly escaping."

\"E_100001_Clip07_050\".m_mContent: "Her confidence feeds on our fear of the unknown. But she forgets. Chaos does not only breed fear—"

\"E_100001_Clip07_051\".m_mContent: "It can also give rise to new possibilities."

\"E_100001_Clip07_052\".m_mContent: "The comet's impact is imminent. We only have a few moments…"

\"E_100001_Clip08a_001\".m_mContent: "Last night revealed much. Walk me through your world—I want to understand your life here... and <style=Highlight>the story of how you became warden</style>."

\"E_100001_Clip08a_002\".m_mContent: "Then it begins with the day I first donned the Warden's mantle."

\"E_100001_Clip08a_004\".m_mContent: "Father! Where's Mother? I brought medicine from the big sister next door—she said it must be taken while it's still hot to work."

\"E_100001_Clip08a_005\".m_mContent: "Now that I think about it... I haven't seen her since before dawn..."

\"E_100001_Clip08a_006\".m_mContent: "...Fanny, set the medicine down. Your mother has gone to a place far, far away. She won't be coming back."

\"E_100001_Clip08a_007\".m_mContent: "There was never hope to begin with. This illness... even the physicians outside would struggle to cure it."

\"E_100001_Clip08a_008\".m_mContent: "You said it's 'difficult to cure'—that means there's still hope! Those physicians outside you spoke of—where are they? Please, tell me! I have to find them!"

\"E_100001_Clip08a_009\".m_mContent: "Haha... They're beyond these walls, on the land that once belonged to 'truth'... but 'ignorance' rules there now. And we who once sought 'truth'... we've been forgotten, forever trapped in this gaol."

\"E_100001_Clip08a_010\".m_mContent: "Even if escape were possible, heretics like me—who dared to pursue forbidden Alchemy—would be hunted down and dragged back into this hell."

\"E_100001_Clip08a_011\".m_mContent: "Father, I don't understand... what is this 'land that once belonged to truth'? Why do you say we've been forgotten, and trapped here?"

\"E_100001_Clip08a_012\".m_mContent: "These are matters far beyond you, child. Of course you wouldn't understand."

\"E_100001_Clip08a_013\".m_mContent: "Even though I've never stepped outside these walls, I don't believe this place is 'hell.' The scriptures say hell is for the truly damned, a place of torment. But Ironfist Gaol feels like sanctuary to me—and the people here are kind."

\"E_100001_Clip08a_014\".m_mContent: "I love this place, and everyone in it. Each has their own quiet corner to study the scriptures. We're blessed with time in the courtyard each day to breath in fresh air. And sometimes, the kind merchant slips me sweet caramel when the guards aren't looking."

\"E_100001_Clip08a_015\".m_mContent: "Scriptures, scriptures, scriptures... Haha... Sweet Fanny, still the lamb among wolves."

\"E_100001_Clip08a_016\".m_mContent: "As long as Father and Mother are with me, anywhere feels like home. But... if your hearts truly yearn for freedom, then I'll follow you!"

\"E_100001_Clip08a_017\".m_mContent: "Then perhaps the time has come, Fanny. Seek out the silver-armored guards. Tell them you wish to become the Warden of this place."

\"E_100001_Clip08a_018\".m_mContent: "Once you hold that mantle... I—no, we—will have our chance to escape."

\"E_100001_Clip08a_019\".m_mContent: "So that's why you made me wear this strange uniform today... You want me to become the Warden."

\"E_100001_Clip08a_020\".m_mContent: "Precisely. Wear it, approach the silver-armored soldiers, tell them your intent. Recite the holy scriptures to them. Do you understand?"

\"E_100001_Clip08a_021\".m_mContent: "But if I become Warden... what happens to the one who serves now? Where will she go?"

\"E_100001_Clip08a_022\".m_mContent: "That is not your concern. The current Warden will find her proper place."

\"E_100001_Clip08a_023\".m_mContent: "Heh... you were right, Fanny. Escape is never impossible—but such chances must be seized with one’s own hands, no matter the cost."

\"E_100001_Clip08_001\".m_mContent: "Alert the Warden at once! The silver-haired heretic and his red-haired accomplice have broken out! Their whereabouts are unknown!"

\"E_100001_Clip08_002\".m_mContent: "Seal every exit! We cannot allow them to escape."

\"E_100001_Clip08_003\".m_mContent: "That accursed thing is still hammering the gaol walls… We can barely stand—how are we meant to chase them down?!"

\"E_100001_Clip08_004\".m_mContent: "These prisoners don't know the gaol's layout, much less which passages lead outside. Finding a way out will take them time."

\"E_100001_Clip08_005\".m_mContent: "Quickly—gather the rest! If we can hardly stand, they are just as affected."

\"E_100001_Clip08_006\".m_mContent: "They discovered us so quickly… Fanny must have informants shadowing our every move."

\"E_100001_Clip08_007\".m_mContent: "That is the deduction from ordinary folks."

\"E_100001_Clip08_008\".m_mContent: "Southeast—then thirty paces right, straight ahead. Henry's cell should be there."

\"E_100001_Clip08_009\".m_mContent: "This tremor's lasting longer than usual… Wait—footsteps? How can there be footsteps…?"

\"E_100001_Clip08_010\".m_mContent: "Noah? Genevieve!? How—how are you outside your cells?!"

\"E_100001_Clip08_011\".m_mContent: "If you're planning a breakout, step one is opening the door."

\"E_100001_Clip08_012\".m_mContent: "And Noah, I'm astonished—one single 'tour,' and you mapped every informant's cell, even traced the entire escape route."

\"E_100001_Clip08_013\".m_mContent: "Not only that one time. Every time they dragged me to interrogation, I heard Henry's voice after descending and turning left."

\"E_100001_Clip08_014\".m_mContent: "So if we pinpoint Henry's position, we can find the stair between floors."

\"E_100001_Clip08_018\".m_mContent: "If the Warden learns you used me to escape, I'm done for!"

\"E_100001_Clip08_020\".m_mContent: "Stairs are round the left corner—this way."

\"E_100001_Clip08_021\".m_mContent: "Wait! You're not taking me with you!?"

\"E_100001_Clip08_022\".m_mContent: "Break out of your own cell first, then we'll talk."

\"E_100001_Clip08_025\".m_mContent: "There they are! Heading for the stairs!"

\"E_100001_Clip08_026\".m_mContent: "Hold them off first—we'll find the stairs after!"

\"E_100001_Clip08_027\".m_mContent: "This floor holds more prisoners than ours ever did."

\"E_100001_Clip08_028\".m_mContent: "Forward, then right—fifty-seven paces northeast. There—Jones's whispered repentence should drift through the shadows."

\"E_100001_Clip08_029\".m_mContent: "…If only I hadn't done those wretched things… I wouldn't be rotting here, haunted by every echo in these cursed walls…"

\"E_100001_Clip08_030\".m_mContent: "That's him—there, the cell to the left."

\"E_100001_Clip08_031\".m_mContent: "Now left, straight for thirty-six paces. You'll smell incense, and the floor—see how the stone tiles rise and sink under countless feet."

\"E_100001_Clip08_034\".m_mContent: "So I wasn't imagining it. You really are breaking out!"

\"E_100001_Clip08_037\".m_mContent: "Follow the stone path, ensuring the incense continues drifting from the left. About twenty paces more… Wait."

\"E_100001_Clip08_038\".m_mContent: "What is it? Something wrong with the path you remember?"

\"E_100001_Clip08_039\".m_mContent: "When they took me to Fanny before, there was no turn here. But now—"

\"E_100001_Clip08_041\".m_mContent: "Why… why did you run off with that woman the moment my back was turned?"

\"E_100001_Clip08_042\".m_mContent: "Didn't you say you wished to understand me? Yet you wander my gaol, prying into its secrets—is this your 'understanding'?"

\"E_100001_Clip08_043\".m_mContent: "You blunder recklessly, yet move as if you know every stone… and it thrills me."

\"E_100001_Clip08_044\".m_mContent: "After all, you are the first prisoner to walk my domain without a blindfold. At last, you see the world as I see it."

\"E_100001_Clip08_045\".m_mContent: "It seems I must trouble you a while longer—before I chain you back where you belong."

\"E_100001_Clip09a_002\".m_mContent: "The current Warden of Ironfist Gaol confirmed deceased. Cause of death—internal organs destroyed by alchemic toxin. Perpetrator remains unidentified. Immediate appointment of successor required."

\"E_100001_Clip09a_003\".m_mContent: "The girl who volunteered days ago will suffice. We require such a vessel—without history, without attachment—to serve our design."

\"E_100001_Clip09a_004\".m_mContent: "Acknowledged. Frequent turnover of wardens has degraded prison stability. Recommend increased surveillance of the Warden to prevent recurrence."

\"E_100001_Clip09a_005\".m_mContent: "If surveillance were enough, Ironfist Gaol would not overflow with such delightful 'accidents.' So this time... she herself shall become the eyes that watch."

\"E_100001_Clip09a_006\".m_mContent: "The silver-armored guards told me this door leads to the world beyond. No prisoner may pass it—yet the key in my hand can open it..."

\"E_100001_Clip09a_009\".m_mContent: "But Father, we haven't even said farewell to everyone here..."

\"E_100001_Clip09a_010\".m_mContent: "The man tore the keys from the girl's hand, trembling as he forced them toward the lock."

\"E_100001_Clip09a_011\".m_mContent: "Heh... you're overthinking it. There's no need for farewells. You can stay here forever."

\"E_100001_Clip09a_012\".m_mContent: "Wh-what do you mean? Aren't we going to the outside world together?"

\"E_100001_Clip09a_013\".m_mContent: "I'm sorry, Fanny... but I never meant to take you with me. You should never have been born. Raised in this cesspit, you're nothing but a puppet of doctrine—unfit to set foot beyond these walls."

\"E_100001_Clip09a_014\".m_mContent: "Your very existence reminds me of my shame—I, once a master of Alchemy, now rotting here, humiliated day after day."

\"E_100001_Clip09a_015\".m_mContent: "Since you first drew breath within these walls, here you shall also breathe your last. From this moment on, I have no daughter... and you, no father."

\"E_100001_Clip09a_018\".m_mContent: "The man thrust open the heavy door and hurled himself headlong into the blazing light beyond."

\"E_100001_Clip09a_021\".m_mContent: "Prisoner No. 681 has escaped without authorization. Subject confirmed deceased. Cause: new Warden Fanny permitted the prisoner's flight. Requesting orders—shall wardenship be revoked and disciplinary measures enacted?"

\"E_100001_Clip09a_022\".m_mContent: "Unnecessary. On the contrary, I shall grant her far greater power—baptize her in our purest doctrine."

\"E_100001_Clip09a_023\".m_mContent: "For what Silver Blood craves above all is precisely such an unburdened vessel."

\"E_100001_Clip09_001\".m_mContent: "The right path has far fewer torches lit than the left… Could it be the wind?"

\"E_100001_Clip09_002\".m_mContent: "The stairwell to the upper level is more exposed. Wind flows more freely there, snuffing out torches along the way."

\"E_100001_Clip09_003\".m_mContent: "I think you had more than one reason for choosing the right path—"

\"E_100001_Clip09_005\".m_mContent: "Once the guards discovered our breakout, they didn't just bar the exits—they summoned reinforcements to hunt us."

\"E_100001_Clip09_006\".m_mContent: "And now, with the comet's impacts, they can't keep their footing. Their steps leave uneven prints; their hands smear against the walls for balance."

\"E_100001_Clip09_007\".m_mContent: "More than that—this passage links upper and lower levels. The wear on the stone is heavier than the other corridor."

\"E_100001_Clip09_008\".m_mContent: "If I'd found you sooner, I might not have wandered so far astray."

\"E_100001_Clip09_009\".m_mContent: "But at least this time, we chose well."

\"E_100001_Clip09_012\".m_mContent: "They must have realized we weren't lost at all. We've been on the right path from the start."

\"E_100001_Clip09_013\".m_mContent: "Exactly. They're not chasing blindly—they've come straight for the stairs."

\"E_100001_Clip09_014\".m_mContent: "Make haste. The guards at the gate, pursuers behind—we'll be trapped between them."

\"E_100001_Clip09_015\".m_mContent: "Good news, you were right about the gate—"

\"E_100001_Clip09_016\".m_mContent: "Stop there! The escapees, I presume? You won't pass me!"

\"E_100001_Clip09_017\".m_mContent: "Bad news—so was mine. Reinforcements at the exit."

\"E_100001_Clip09_018\".m_mContent: "Then the key must be on him."

\"E_100001_Clip09_019\".m_mContent: "All the more reason we should deal with this quickly—"

\"E_100001_Clip09_021\".m_mContent: "The key fits… It's open. Let's go, Noah."

\"E_100001_Clip09_022\".m_mContent: "Be prepared—we've no idea what waits beyond."

\"E_100001_Clip09_025\".m_mContent: "It matches our suspicion. Fanny's confidence was no bluff—she believes there's no true escape."

\"E_100001_Clip09_026\".m_mContent: "She built the gaol inside the realm's turbulence itself, with time as the barrier. Time that unravels all things."

\"E_100001_Clip09_027\".m_mContent: "Even beyond our cells, we still haven't escaped these walls."

\"E_100001_Clip09_030\".m_mContent: "That is why no prisoner escapes, and why the comet cannot destroy this gaol—this place is an island severed from the current of time."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_002\".m_mContent: "I repeat: what crime did you commit?"

\"E_100001_Clip10a_003\".m_mContent: "What crime...? I'm not a criminal! I'm the Warden—I care for everyone, I do good!"

\"E_100001_Clip10a_004\".m_mContent: "As Warden, you released a dangerous prisoner. That led directly to his death."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_005\".m_mContent: "That was my father! He said there's someone outside who could cure Mother's sickness—I only wanted to help him!"

\"E_100001_Clip10a_006\".m_mContent: "Your so-called help is what killed him. Repeat: what is your crime?"

\"E_100001_Clip10a_007\".m_mContent: "I... I don't know... I only wanted to make Father happy..."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_008\".m_mContent: "(cracking of a whip) The whip tore across the girl's flesh."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_009\".m_mContent: "I... what did I do wrong? Please—just tell me, I'll make it right!"

\"E_100001_Clip10a_010\".m_mContent: "It's clear now: your sin drove your father to abandon you. His death was the consequence of your failure. Only through devout faith in Aeon can you find redemption."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_012\".m_mContent: "Recite the First Chapter of the Doctrine."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_013\".m_mContent: "I won't recite those strange words! I need to go back— The merchant's leg is still hurt... And the big sister next door, she must be so worried about me!"

\"E_100001_Clip10a_014\".m_mContent: "Those people? They are sinners, unworthy of your pity."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_015\".m_mContent: "They're not sinners! The merchant shares his bread with the hungry, and big sister prays for the sick! They're good people!"

\"E_100001_Clip10a_016\".m_mContent: "Prisons hold criminals. If they were truly good, why would they be behind bars?"

\"E_100001_Clip10a_018\".m_mContent: "Because they committed crimes. Just as you did. Now, recite the Doctrine."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_019\".m_mContent: "Kindness... unbridled kindness is... is the breeding ground of evil..."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_021\".m_mContent: "Now—do you still believe those prisoners deserve your pity?"

\"E_100001_Clip10a_022\".m_mContent: "But they... they cry sometimes... and they feel pain..."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_023\".m_mContent: "They cry because they have not suffered enough. Pain is the purification of sin. You must grant them more suffering, not pity."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_025\".m_mContent: "Exactly. That is the Warden's duty. Repeat it."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_026\".m_mContent: "A Warden's duty is... to ensure the guilty suffer as they deserve..."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_027\".m_mContent: "If a prisoner begs you for mercy, what will you do?"

\"E_100001_Clip10a_028\".m_mContent: "I will... increase their torment... for mercy is proof they remain unrepentant..."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_029\".m_mContent: "Correct. Criminals don't deserve kindness, and neither do you."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_031\".m_mContent: "You are guilty of sin, therefore unworthy. When will you become worthy? Reflect on this."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_032\".m_mContent: "When I... when I have paid for my sins?"

\"E_100001_Clip10a_033\".m_mContent: "Excellent. And how will you pay for them?"

\"E_100001_Clip10a_034\".m_mContent: "By becoming... a proper warden... showing no mercy to the guilty..."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_035\".m_mContent: "Very good. Now recite Chapter Ten of the Doctrine."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_036\".m_mContent: "Evil springs from weakness of the heart. Forgiveness betrays justice; compassion defiles order..."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_038\".m_mContent: "And your father's death—what do you make of it?"

\"E_100001_Clip10a_039\".m_mContent: "Father... Father was a sinner... He died because... because he deserved his fate..."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_040\".m_mContent: "Then, given that your father was a sinner who abandoned you, do you hate him?"

\"E_100001_Clip10a_041\".m_mContent: "I don't hate. Hatred is emotion... and I should not feel. I exist only to serve my purpose."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_042\".m_mContent: "Excellent. Today brings a rather special trial."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_043\".m_mContent: "This creature was born beyond time's river—a living paradox. I place it in your hands now. What will you do with it?"

\"E_100001_Clip10a_045\".m_mContent: "The person you once were would have saved it."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_046\".m_mContent: "The old me was misguided... showing mercy to sinful creatures was wasted compassion."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_048\".m_mContent: "The girl cradled the small bird in her hands. It fluttered weakly against her frigid palms before its fragile life ebbed into stillness."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_049\".m_mContent: "Excellent. You are prepared to be reborn."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_051\".m_mContent: "Fanny, ninety days of purification have stripped you of human frailty. Now you shall be sanctified, and rise as the perfect Warden."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_052\".m_mContent: "I understand. I will become what this prison demands of me."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_054\".m_mContent: "I... I can still feel my mother's warm hands... hear Father's tales of myths and heroes... taste the merchant's sweet caramel... But none of that matters anymore."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_056\".m_mContent: "Then... then let them all disappear... please, let me be innocent again..."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_057\".m_mContent: "The warmth... slipping away... the pain... fading too... every... sensation... vanishing..."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_058\".m_mContent: "This way... I can never make another mistake..."

\"E_100001_Clip10a_059\".m_mContent: "From that day forth, the girl who longed for her parents, who wept for fallen birds, who smiled at the taste of caramel—died. What remained was a perfect Warden: without compassion, without weakness, without humanity."

\"E_100001_Clip10_001\".m_mContent: "Surprised? You knew long ago this was where realm-prisoners were kept, yet you never imagined the outside would look like this, did you?"

\"E_100001_Clip10_002\".m_mContent: "How cruel. You could have warned us what awaited, yet you chose to let us stumble blind."

\"E_100001_Clip10_003\".m_mContent: "Ah—is it not interesting? The despair that lingers when hope is torn away… It is the flavor I have savored since the day of my birth."

\"E_100001_Clip10_004\".m_mContent: "And now, my dear prisoners, I would have you taste it too."

\"E_100001_Clip10_007\".m_mContent: "It was our negligence. Please, punish us, Warden!"

\"E_100001_Clip10_008\".m_mContent: "We'll return the escapees to their cell at once!"

\"E_100001_Clip10_010\".m_mContent: "I wish to see this play out. They will choose for themselves… won't they, my prisoners?"

\"E_100001_Clip10_011\".m_mContent: "Since you've glimpsed my past and memories, you should know: though I, as Death, have been stripped of power, Death's essence remains unaltered."

\"E_100001_Clip10_012\".m_mContent: "The turbulence cannot kill you—only aid your escape. Is that what you mean, my dear prisoner?"

\"E_100001_Clip10_013\".m_mContent: "Though I suspect you cannot bring yourself to abandon that red-haired woman, can you?"

\"E_100001_Clip10_014\".m_mContent: "My purpose was always his safe departure. If you think you can wield me as a chain to bind Noah, you are gravely mistaken."

\"E_100001_Clip10_015\".m_mContent: "Choose, my favorite prisoner—return to the cell we share, or depart in solitude. The choice is yours."

\"E_100001_Clip10_016\".m_mContent: "Warden, I fear this violates proper protocol..."

\"E_100001_Clip10_018\".m_mContent: "No… I wouldn't dare… but—the Church has sent their own."

\"E_100001_Clip10_019\".m_mContent: "Then so be it. My dear prisoner, I shall wait for your answer. One that satisfies me."

\"E_100001_Clip10_020\".m_mContent: "Come, Noah. The path is perilous, but these temporal currents should pose little threat to one such as you."

\"E_100001_Clip10_022\".m_mContent: "Silver-haired heretic Noah Nevernight. Red-haired heretic Genevieve. Attempting escape. Apprehend immediately—"

\"E_100001_Clip10_02201\".m_mContent: "Noah, go! I'll hold them off. Ahhh—!!!"

\"E_100001_Clip10_02202\".m_mContent: "The Church's blades shriek through the air, cutting Genevieve down again and again."

\"E_100001_Clip10_02203\".m_mContent: "*Cough, cough*—Noah—don't look back—you have to make it out alive—"

\"E_100001_Clip10_02204\".m_mContent: "Seems you don't know me as well as you think…"

\"E_100001_Clip10_02205\".m_mContent: "Abandon my companions and flee alone? I'm sorry, but that has never been who I am."

\"E_100001_Clip10_02206\".m_mContent: "You've always wondered why I've fought so desperately to get you out of here, haven't you?"

\"E_100001_Clip10_02207\".m_mContent: "This dagger that has accompanied me all this time... it holds all the answers you seek. Take it. When you break free from this prison, the truth will reveal itself."

\"E_100001_Clip10_02209\".m_mContent: "Take it, Noah. It was yours from the beginning."

\"E_100001_Clip10_02211\".m_mContent: "I never meant to worry you. Come now, don't look at me like that—I'm perfectly fine."

\"E_100001_Clip10_02212\".m_mContent: "Haven't you noticed? Ever since we entered this prison, our wounds have been healing mysteriously come nightfall."

\"E_100001_Clip10_02213\".m_mContent: "I only acted that way to see the worry in your eyes. It's so rare to have you care for me like this."

\"E_100001_Clip10_02214\".m_mContent: "Now, help me up. The path before us won't be any easier."

\"E_100001_Clip10_023\".m_mContent: "These guards and Church weapons wandering these halls were once ordinary souls, like you and me. Now they are prisoners, cast beyond time's reach."

\"E_100001_Clip10_024\".m_mContent: "I cannot fathom what drives their desperation, yet sometimes… I almost admire it. Had my own people shown such resolve, perhaps our fate would have been different."

\"E_100001_Clip10_025\".m_mContent: "We may be prisoners under their watch, but are they not prisoners as well—bound by time itself?"

\"E_100001_Clip10_026\".m_mContent: "If we are to break free, this is our moment. Hurry, Noah—return to that Timeline. There are still others waiting for you, unfinished tales only you can write."

\"E_100001_Clip10_027\".m_mContent: "And yet… another path lies before us."

\"E_100001_Clip10_028\".m_mContent: "Why are you looking at the prison? Wait—you cannot mean—"

\"E_100001_Clip10_029\".m_mContent: "Fanny. She may know where the true exit lies."

\"E_100001_Clip10_030\".m_mContent: "Kidnapping the Warden may sound possible, but you underestimate her."

\"E_100001_Clip10_031\".m_mContent: "Anyone who rules this place commands power beyond all others here."

\"E_100001_Clip10_032\".m_mContent: "I have no wish to use her as a bargaining chip."

\"E_100001_Clip10_033\".m_mContent: "I want to bring her with us and leave this place together."

\"E_100001_Clip11_001\".m_mContent: "I still don't understand. You should flee at once, not return for her."

\"E_100001_Clip11_002\".m_mContent: "If I leave, you'll be stuck here."

\"E_100001_Clip11_003\".m_mContent: "My mission is simple: to save you. You may not remember, but I am not like you. I have wandered the currents of time far too long— Even if I left, I might never find the right place."

\"E_100001_Clip11_004\".m_mContent: "The right place? I believe you've already found it."

\"E_100001_Clip11_006\".m_mContent: "Time has cast you out. History has expelled you from its cycle. But there remains one place you may yet dwell."

\"E_100001_Clip11_008\".m_mContent: "All must face their death. Only death is truly fair in this world."

\"E_100001_Clip11_009\".m_mContent: "Though 'Death' may seem the end of fate, it is no less the beginning of life anew."

\"E_100001_Clip11_010\".m_mContent: "I had never thought of it that way before…"

\"E_100001_Clip11_011\".m_mContent: "—If 'Death' still has a place beside him, then perhaps… I might not be opposed to joining him."

\"E_100001_Clip11_012\".m_mContent: "Come—Fanny's quarters lie just ahead. It's time we faced the real her."

\"E_100001_Clip11_013\".m_mContent: "I still don't understand why you want to take her with us."

\"E_100001_Clip11_014\".m_mContent: "Fanny was born and raised in Ironfist Gaol. Whatever she knows of the outside world, she's stolen from the memories of others."

\"E_100001_Clip11_015\".m_mContent: "Why would someone like her even wish to leave?"

\"E_100001_Clip11_016\".m_mContent: "What do you hope to gain by making me a free man?"

\"E_100001_Clip11_017\".m_mContent: "To break free from the temporal loop that has bound us, to let time flow forward again. But that has nothing to do with what I asked."

\"E_100001_Clip11_018\".m_mContent: "No, quite the opposite. She's no different from us. Like every soul bound to this place—prisoner or jailer—she remains a captive, with no way out."

\"E_100001_Clip11_019\".m_mContent: "She knows it better than anyone. That is why she's fixated on other people's pasts, tasting their stories through blood."

\"E_100001_Clip11_020\".m_mContent: "So you see it too—that yearning for the world beyond…"

\"E_100001_Clip11_021\".m_mContent: "She's lived so long in her cage that she's forgotten she once had wings."

\"E_100001_Clip11_023\".m_mContent: "When she peered into my past, I caught glimpses of hers in return."

\"E_100001_Clip11_024\".m_mContent: "You two, halt! Beyond this point lies the Warden's chamber of interrogation. None may pass!"

\"E_100001_Clip11_026\".m_mContent: "But no one's here. She came to meet us earlier, yet never returned."

\"E_100001_Clip11_027\".m_mContent: "Wait—these are the Warden's keys. She was here, then left. For one so cautious, she'd never abandon something this vital."

\"E_100001_Clip11_028\".m_mContent: "A Warden's duty is to keep prisoners from escaping. And yet, she offered me the choice to depart alone."

\"E_100001_Clip11_030\".m_mContent: "That someone reached her first—took hold of her before we could."

\"E_100001_Clip11_031\".m_mContent: "Aaah—! By Aeon's will… I—I accept your divine judgment…"

\"E_100001_Clip11_032\".m_mContent: "It's Fanny. She's being punished. From the sound of it… it's on the eastern side—the spire closest to the heavens."

\"E_100001_Clip11_033\".m_mContent: "Noah, are you certain you still wish to find her? By now, the Church will have filled that place with their weapons."

\"E_100001_Clip11_034\".m_mContent: "Yes—strike again! Your puppet of mine begs for torment! Let me find meaning in this sacred affliction—!"

\"E_100001_Clip11_035\".m_mContent: "She saw it with her own eyes—saw how those who longed for freedom tried to flee this place."

\"E_100001_Clip11_036\".m_mContent: "We may have failed, but a seed was sown in her heart."

\"E_100001_Clip11_037\".m_mContent: "This is the moment to rescue her. She'll finally see who her true captors are."

\"E_100001_Clip12_001\".m_mContent: "I've never felt this before… The sky is so near I could almost touch it, yet it's so far that I... can't grasp it."

\"E_100001_Clip12_002\".m_mContent: "If I were to leap, the exquisite agony of my body breaking might grant me bliss beyond imagination… like the taste of your blood."

\"E_100001_Clip12_003\".m_mContent: "But I can't. I'm bound to these walls, so even death remains a mercy beyond my reach."

\"E_100001_Clip12_004\".m_mContent: "Warning: Discipline protocol in progress. Remain still. Cease all unnecessary actions."

\"E_100001_Clip12_005\".m_mContent: "Ahhh—!!! Pain... more pain... only through agony can I forget my sins, even for a moment..."

\"E_100001_Clip12_006\".m_mContent: "If I could wash them all away, would I be worthy then? Worthy enough that you would choose to stay...?"

\"E_100001_Clip12_007\".m_mContent: "Noah... Genevieve... why did you come here...? Fools—you'll be punished..."

\"E_100001_Clip12_010\".m_mContent: "We found the key that could free us, but we cannot get it yet."

\"E_100001_Clip12_011\".m_mContent: "Don't you see? There is no key. No escape. This is where it all ends."

\"E_100001_Clip12_012\".m_mContent: "The key, she stands before us now."

\"E_100001_Clip12_013\".m_mContent: "Shall I take that as your confession, Noah?"

\"E_100001_Clip12_015\".m_mContent: "Come with us, Fanny. Leave this place behind. Genevieve, now!"

\"E_100001_Clip12_017\".m_mContent: "Warning: Anomaly detected in Ironfist Gaol. Requesting immediate reinforcements. Repeat—requesting immediate reinforcements."

\"E_100001_Clip12_018\".m_mContent: "Noah… thank you. But it's too late. The prison has taken root in me, it won't let me go."

\"E_100001_Clip12_019\".m_mContent: "Then I will sever the roots that bind you."

\"E_100001_Clip12_020\".m_mContent: "Because this prison—or rather, the temporal storm that enshrouds it—is a part of you."

\"E_100001_Clip12_021\".m_mContent: "Ever since we arrived, hunger, thirst—all such needs—have vanished."

\"E_100001_Clip12_022\".m_mContent: "And no matter how savage the torment, by dawn the prisoners' wounds are gone, as if they had never bled at all."

\"E_100001_Clip12_023\".m_mContent: "Rather than a prison, it is an island cut adrift beyond time itself."

\"E_100001_Clip12_024\".m_mContent: "No—worse. It's a void, severed from existence by a power beyond reason."

\"E_100001_Clip12_025\".m_mContent: "Yet you sense all that unfolds within these walls—our whispered plots, the guards' movements, the prisoners' routines..."

\"E_100001_Clip12_026\".m_mContent: "They bound you here to sustain this prison. You are its beating heart."

\"E_100001_Clip12_027\".m_mContent: "Such stories, my favorite prisoner. But if you truly believe them, why not kill me outright? Why burden yourself with someone like me...?"

\"E_100001_Clip12_028\".m_mContent: "Because you and I—like everyone else—do not belong here. We belong out there, beneath the open sky."

\"E_100001_Clip12_030\".m_mContent: "I was raised within stone walls and iron bars. I never knew childhood, only decrees. Never knew games, only judgment."

\"E_100001_Clip12_031\".m_mContent: "The Codex Sanctus were my fairy tales, the torture rack my only toys."

\"E_100001_Clip12_032\".m_mContent: "They crowned me Warden, made me recite the Sanctus, as if those words could fill my hollow heart. But I know the truth—I am nothing but a shell, a marionette that speaks when pulled by strings."

\"E_100001_Clip12_033\".m_mContent: "Until you, my dear prisoner. Even knowing you act only to escape, you were the first to truly see me—to strip away the mask, to pierce through my facade."

\"E_100001_Clip12_034\".m_mContent: "But cages are all I have ever known. The door stands open, yet I dare not step through."

\"E_100001_Clip12_035\".m_mContent: "If a bird abandons its cage, then what becomes of the cage?"

\"E_100001_Clip12_036\".m_mContent: "So kill me. As you said, this prison is part of me. End me, and you will be free."

\"E_100001_Clip12_037\".m_mContent: "The dead from the collision, your desperate flight—these mark my failure as Warden."

\"E_100001_Clip12_038\".m_mContent: "Death… let it serve as my penance."

\"E_100001_Clip12_039\".m_mContent: "I've... failed. And I accept whatever punishment awaits."

\"E_100001_Clip12_040\".m_mContent: "No. That so-called duty of yours is nothing but the shape of your torment. Stop weaving your own cocoon."

\"E_100001_Clip12_041\".m_mContent: "I have chosen. My prisoners—seek your freedom within my flesh."

\"E_100001_Clip12_043\".m_mContent: "Wait, Noah, how did you get a sword..."

\"E_100001_Clip12_046\".m_mContent: "Whether it be you or us… we are all birds, trapped within the same cage."

\"E_100001_Clip12_046a\".m_mContent: "Noah caught Fanny as she collapsed, his teeth sinking gently into the curve of her neck."

\"E_100001_Clip12_049\".m_mContent: "Become my Vassal… let me grant you the power to pursue freedom—"

\"E_100001_Clip12_053\".m_mContent: "That… that was a memory buried inside her power?!"

\"E_100001_Clip12_054\".m_mContent: "Then let me set you free, Fanny."

\"E_100001_Clip12_055\".m_mContent: "What—what's happening?! Why is the whole place shaking like this?!"

\"E_100001_Clip12_059\".m_mContent: "Stay behind to guard the prisoners. The rest of you—come with me! We must find the Warden!"

\"E_100001_Clip12_060\".m_mContent: "The rift in the temporal currents is closing… Did we succeed?"

\"E_100001_Clip12_064\".m_mContent: "At the very least, she is no longer the Fanny we knew. Now she holds the power to seek her freedom."

\"E_100001_Clip12_067\".m_mContent: "Move! Get men on the prisoners before they riot!"

\"E_100001_Clip12_068\".m_mContent: "Has Ironfist Gaol truly fallen into complete chaos…"

\"E_100001_Clip12_069\".m_mContent: "The force that sustained this realm vanished the moment I became bound to you."

\"E_100001_Clip12_070\".m_mContent: "But it doesn't matter… Aeon and the Saint will surely send another to take my place."

\"E_100001_Clip12_071\".m_mContent: "Perhaps we should leave this place while the rift is still open."

\"E_100001_Clip12_072\".m_mContent: "I'll send you out. It was always part of my power. Escaping this place… will not be difficult."

\"E_100001_Clip12_074\".m_mContent: "Can't you hear them? The people here... they're still calling out to me."

\"E_100001_Clip12_075\".m_mContent: "But it matters not—one day, I'll catch up to you. I'll find my way back to your side."

\"E_100001_Clip12_076\".m_mContent: "I had hoped to hear more of your story… but that will have to wait for another time."

\"E_100001_Clip12_078\".m_mContent: "Go where you must. I'll entrust you to that insufferable redhead's care."

\"E_100001_Clip12_080\".m_mContent: "I will find you again… somewhere amid tomorrow's shattered fragments."

\"E_100001_Clip12_081\".m_mContent: "Of countless fates, every one casts us as foes."

\"E_100001_Clip12_082\".m_mContent: "Yet none would dream… that we might stand as one."

\"E_100001_Clip12_083\".m_mContent: "Another troublesome affair… though not beyond reach."

\"E_100001_Clip12_084\".m_mContent: "Mass Carrelle... No, I should call her by her true name—Genevieve Carrelle. An old companion of mine, a fugitive trapped in a temporal prison. Like you, she carries the same hunger to reach the end."

\"E_100001_Clip12_085\".m_mContent: "The cruel irony: no common means will ever free you both from that temporal prison."

\"E_100001_Clip12_086\".m_mContent: "Since it's a temporal prison, it must follow the cycle of time. She can begin at the end; we'll meet at the beginning, and only then will the escape be complete."

\"E_100001_Clip12_087\".m_mContent: "But at the beginning, all is unknown. Are you truly so certain you'll place your trust in a stranger who approaches without cause?"

\"E_100001_Clip12_088\".m_mContent: "If one knew every step in advance, fear would smother resolve. Thus ignorance itself becomes my greatest weapon."

\"E_100001_Clip12_089\".m_mContent: "Do not forget—avert the Scourge, break the cycle, save all Timelines. This is our eternal charge."

\"E_100001_Clip12_090\".m_mContent: "Next stop: Ironfist Gaol, the cage of time."

\"E_100001_Clip12_091\".m_mContent: "Go forth, collide with it. Ashes of Time—the pale bird of judgment."

\"E_100001_Clip12_092\".m_mContent: "So... you've returned to my side, Noah."

\"E_100001_Clip12_093\".m_mContent: "Tell me, how do you intend to end it this time?"

\"E_100001_Clip12_094\".m_mContent: "I believe we've found our path to the end."

\"E_100001_Clip12_095\".m_mContent: "Oh? I never thought this carriage would truly come to a halt. Now… who could have managed such a feat?"

\"E_100001_Clip12_096\".m_mContent: "It seems… a 'friend' has come from the end of time."

\"L_Albert_10_01\".m_mContent: "Your payment awaits on that table—something I believe might be of interest."

\"L_Albert_10_02\".m_mContent: "Inside the bottle, another world is contained, not the Aurum Perfectum you spoke of earlier."

\"L_Albert_10_03\".m_mContent: "You see, that was but one component required in my search. I never claimed it was the ultimate prize."

\"L_Albert_10_04\".m_mContent: "Treasure it well. It represents my most perfect creation to date—the only place where observation won't get interrupted."

\"L_Albert_10_05\".m_mContent: "Inside here, you are able to glimpse your former self, no?"

\"L_Albert_10_06\".m_mContent: "Though history is riddled with countless coincidences, they all converge toward inevitable outcomes—be it my appearance, or the demise of others."

\"L_Albert_10_07\".m_mContent: "If that's the case, how can you be sure this "world" won't collapse at some predetermined moment, just like the previous ones?"

\"L_Albert_10_08\".m_mContent: "That is precisely why I had you observe the other worlds—"

\"L_Albert_10_09\".m_mContent: "Since we cannot forestall a collapse, we must forge an existence that transgresses the bounds of history."

\"L_Albert_10_10\".m_mContent: "So you chose a version of yourself from a distant past."

\"L_Albert_10_11\".m_mContent: "The "self" within the bottle will inevitably follow history's course, discovering more "worlds" that exist beyond time—thus here, the cycle of observation will then be complete."

\"L_Albert_10_12\".m_mContent: "You seem quite confident this "self" will be capable of researching and creating "worlds.""

\"L_Albert_10_13\".m_mContent: "Because the "self" in the bottle is still Albrecht."
