\"L_Albert_10_14\".m_mContent: "It seems you've entrusted me with more than just the bottle—you've also placed another "Albrecht" into my care."

\"L_Albert_10_15\".m_mContent: "Given your curiosity, this bottle may serve an even greater purpose in your hands."

\"L_Albert_10_16\".m_mContent: "I assumed you'd share this bottle with those students of yours."

\"L_Albert_10_17\".m_mContent: "Though they have their own merits in Alchemy, compared to you, they all lack one crucial element—"

\"L_Albert_10_19\".m_mContent: "When that name passes your lips, I sense it carries meaning beyond my existence."

\"L_Albert_10_20\".m_mContent: "I've always known that my 'selves' throughout the realms would continue to discover other worlds, but only Noah Nevernight can truly grasp the significance of this breakthrough."

\"L_Albert_10_23\".m_mContent: "Your fascination with my past stems not from mere reward, but from a deeper yearning."

\"L_Albert_10_24\".m_mContent: "Endlessly searching for the past, constantly grasping for the future—you and I are of one spirit."

\"L_Albert_10_25\".m_mContent: "It seems you have also discovered my past within this vessel."

\"L_Albert_10_26\".m_mContent: "—Or perhaps it's because we share the same fate."

\"L_Albert_10_27\".m_mContent: "I never imagined a Bell Ringer of the Church would confess such things to a Heretic."

\"L_Albert_10_28\".m_mContent: "You seem confused. From the very beginning, I was never granted Silver Blood—I chose it."

\"L_Albert_10_29\".m_mContent: "I needed a suitable vessel for my memories, and the Church sought someone strong enough to inherit Silver Blood... just as you did with 'Death.'"

\"L_Albert_10_30\".m_mContent: "The same spirit... so that's what you meant."

\"L_Albert_10_31\".m_mContent: "Perhaps at this very moment, our other selves contemplate these same questions."

\"L_Albert_10_32\".m_mContent: "Would you care to hear what they think?"

\"L_Albert_10_34\".m_mContent: "Beyond the boundaries of time, countless copies of Noah and Albrecht may exist, yet no matter who—"

\"L_Albert_10_35\".m_mContent: "They all arrive at the same conclusion."

\"L_Stella_10_02\".m_mContent: "What is it? You want to come with us?"

\"L_Stella_10_04\".m_mContent: "Will you have enough energy for the journey?"

\"L_Stella_10_05\".m_mContent: "At my question, the little construct paused—pretending to doze—then suddenly sprang to life."

\"L_Stella_10_06\".m_mContent: "Ah... so you'll sleep through the journey, and wake once we arrive?"

\"L_Stella_10_08\".m_mContent: "Smarter than I gave you credit for."

\"L_Stella_10_09\".m_mContent: "Asta comes alive at night. The festival's warmth has taken hold of everyone. No matter where you turn, you'll hear cheers and raised glasses—echoes of a city that won't rest."

\"L_Stella_10_10\".m_mContent: "Look at all the people out at night!"

\"L_Stella_10_11\".m_mContent: "Silly wolf! Stop gawking like some country bumpkin."

\"L_Stella_10_12\".m_mContent: "You're not just Ganelon's representative. You're also part of the Bathorys!"

\"L_Stella_10_13\".m_mContent: "Even back in Bathory lands, it's never this crowded."

\"L_Stella_10_14\".m_mContent: "Just Blood Servants... and a stinky bat flapping everywhere."

\"L_Stella_10_15\".m_mContent: "Who are you calling a stinky bat?!"

\"L_Stella_10_17\".m_mContent: "It's not often we get a chance like this—let's enjoy the festival while we can."

\"L_Stella_10_18\".m_mContent: "There are too many eyes and ears in a place like this. If word of our true identities spreads, it could invite trouble."

\"L_Stella_10_22\".m_mContent: "A keepsake from Stella. Before I left, it kept clinging to me—refused to let me go alone."

\"L_Stella_10_24\".m_mContent: "The little construct bounced indignantly, clearly unimpressed by Noah's words."

\"L_Stella_10_26\".m_mContent: "I want to find the best spot to watch the fireworks!"

\"L_Stella_10_31\".m_mContent: "I moved alone, the construct at my side, pushing against the tide of departing revelers."

\"L_Stella_10_32\".m_mContent: "The ceremony was over. The crowd that once surrounded the bell tower was already gone."

\"L_Stella_10_33\".m_mContent: "As a gesture of farewell to the past, this year's festival moved the fireworks to a new location."

\"L_Stella_10_34\".m_mContent: "With the bell-ringing complete, the crowd moved on toward the festival's fireworks."

\"L_Stella_10_35\".m_mContent: "Revelry and wine flowed freely, seeping into every corner of the city."

\"L_Stella_10_36\".m_mContent: "And yet, the bell tower remained—silent, enduring, keeping its eternal vigil."

\"L_Stella_10_37\".m_mContent: "I ascended the tower, step by step, until I reached its summit."

\"L_Stella_10_38\".m_mContent: "The last time I stood here... Stella was at my side."

\"L_Stella_10_39\".m_mContent: "And without my noticing, another celebration had already begun."

\"L_Stella_10_40\".m_mContent: "I wonder how many years have passed in her world."

\"L_Stella_10_41\".m_mContent: "Has time aged her... perhaps into an old woman by now?"

\"L_Stella_10_42\".m_mContent: "Typical of the exalted—to forget so easily."

\"L_Stella_10_43\".m_mContent: "Have you forgotten? Like you, I'm a Bloodborn."

\"L_Stella_10_47\".m_mContent: "At my feet, the small construct looked up at me, tendrils swaying as if reaching for my hand."

\"L_Stella_10_48\".m_mContent: "You... are you trapped inside this construct?"

\"L_Stella_10_51\".m_mContent: "It's just a bit of cross-realm signal transmission."

\"L_Stella_10_52\".m_mContent: "When needed, I can reach you through it."

\"L_Stella_10_53\".m_mContent: "You can really do something like that...?"

\"L_Stella_10_54\".m_mContent: "Time flows differently between our worlds, and our technologies are worlds apart. It's only natural you wouldn't understand."

\"L_Stella_10_57\".m_mContent: "So you're speaking to me from your world... and this little construct carries your voice to mine."

\"L_Stella_10_58\".m_mContent: "Exactly. I'm still aboard the El Dorado."

\"L_Stella_10_59\".m_mContent: "Captain Ami and Regina are behind me. Want to say hello?"

\"L_Stella_10_62\".m_mContent: "The little construct crept to my side and nestled into place."

\"L_Stella_10_63\".m_mContent: "Stella's voice drifted from within—at times clear, at times worn and frayed."

\"L_Stella_10_64\".m_mContent: "Even across worlds, I could still hear the excitement in Stella's voice as she recounted her journey."

\"L_Stella_10_65\".m_mContent: "...Back then, we had Regina's salt to thank."

\"L_Stella_10_68\".m_mContent: "This way of reaching me... does it carry only sound?"

\"L_Stella_10_69\".m_mContent: "You picked that up faster than I imagined."

\"L_Stella_10_70\".m_mContent: "No, it doesn't only carry sound—I can see your world through the construct's eyes..."

\"L_Stella_10_72\".m_mContent: "After Stella's reply, I gently cupped the construct in my hands, staring into its emerald eyes."

\"L_Stella_10_73\".m_mContent: "Why is everything shaking? Is there an earthquake? Are you getting attacked by constructs again?"

\"L_Stella_10_74\".m_mContent: "Wait... Noah? You're awfully close, aren't you?"

\"L_Stella_10_75\".m_mContent: "I couldn't read her expression through the construct's polished eyes, but her voice held a tremor—light, but unmistakable."

\"L_Stella_10_76\".m_mContent: "And as if it sensed her unease, the construct squirmed faintly in my grip."

\"L_Stella_10_78\".m_mContent: "I want you to see them too."

\"L_Stella_10_81\".m_mContent: "It's so blurry... I can only make out a few points of light."

\"L_Stella_10_85\".m_mContent: "That was the firelight from exploding constructs—not fireworks."

\"L_Stella_10_88\".m_mContent: "And when you return, we'll watch them—together."

\"L_Stella_10_89\".m_mContent: "The construct stirred once more in my hands—then fell still."

\"L_Stella_10_91\".m_mContent: "I placed the construct gently on my shoulder. And together—with Stella—we watched the fireworks bloom across the divide between worlds."

\"L_Funa_10_03\".m_mContent: "The bedroom looks the same as always, the sheets soft beneath me. And yet... something feels wrong."

\"L_Funa_10_05\".m_mContent: "Fanny, whom I haven't seen in ages, lies on her side next to me, watching me with a spark of mischief in her eyes."

\"L_Funa_10_07\".m_mContent: "You said you were looking forward to seeing me again. Now I'm here. Aren't you happy?"

\"L_Funa_10_10\".m_mContent: "Fanny rises and swings a leg over me, fingers tightening around my throat."

\"L_Funa_10_13\".m_mContent: "You don't look very happy to me."

\"L_Funa_10_18\".m_mContent: "Then we'd be running from the Church together."

\"L_Funa_10_21\".m_mContent: "I slipped out on my own. It's been too long... I wanted to see you."

\"L_Funa_10_23\".m_mContent: "My hand brushes through her loosened hair. She leans forward without warning, pressing me down."

\"L_Funa_10_24\".m_mContent: "Now tell me. Did they break you?"

\"L_Funa_10_25\".m_mContent: "Why don't you find out for yourself?"

\"L_Funa_10_26\".m_mContent: "Fabric shifts against skin. Heat. The sound of restraint unraveling."

\"L_Funa_10_29\".m_mContent: "Those little tricks aren't enough to scar me."

\"L_Funa_10_30\".m_mContent: "Besides, the Church specializes in more... refined methods. Potions that torment the mind."

\"L_Funa_10_32\".m_mContent: "Only the pain you give can bring me such exquisite pleasure."

\"L_Funa_10_33\".m_mContent: "I'll make you feel that way again."

\"L_Funa_10_35\".m_mContent: "Her hand glides over my skin, hot against the cold of my body."

\"L_Funa_10_38\".m_mContent: "Let me taste your blood once more."

\"L_Evna_02_01\".m_mContent: "The rift in the temporal currents is closing… Ironfist is crumbling... Noah, did we finally succeed this time?"

\"L_Evna_02_02\".m_mContent: "This time? Has this scene unfolded before?"

\"L_Evna_02_03\".m_mContent: "No time for explanations now. Do you feel it? Our consciousness is slipping away from these vessels... We'll return to the original timeline soon. Until we meet again in Minexus."

\"L_Evna_02_04\".m_mContent: "That black dagger I entrusted to you holds every answer you seek—the truth behind why I chose to help you."

\"L_Evna_02_06\".m_mContent: "Wait—at least tell me who sent you to help me."

\"L_Evna_02_07\".m_mContent: "Hehe... you haven't figured it out yet, have you?"

\"L_Evna_02_09\".m_mContent: "It's been several days since I left Ironfist and returned to this familiar timeline, yet Genevieve's origins remain shrouded in mystery."

\"L_Evna_02_10\".m_mContent: "Genevieve entrusted this dagger to me before she vanished. She promised that within its steel lay all the answers I sought."

\"L_Evna_02_11\".m_mContent: "It appears to be nothing more than an ordinary dagger, always worn around Genevieve's neck—yet she insists it belongs to me... How peculiar."

\"L_Evna_02_12\".m_mContent: "Wait... the dagger—it's heating up... What's happening? Time itself is rewinding."

\"L_Evna_02_13\".m_mContent: "Of countless fates, every one casts us as foes."

\"L_Evna_02_14\".m_mContent: "Yet none would dream… that we might stand as one."

\"L_Evna_02_15\".m_mContent: "Another troublesome affair… though not beyond reach."

\"L_Evna_02_16\".m_mContent: "Mass Carrelle... No, I should call her by her true name—Genevieve Carrelle. An old companion of mine, a fugitive trapped in a temporal prison. Like you, she carries the same hunger to reach the end."

\"L_Evna_02_17\".m_mContent: "The cruel irony: no common means will ever free you both from that temporal prison."

\"L_Evna_02_18\".m_mContent: "Since it's a temporal prison, it must follow the cycle of time. She can begin from the end, and I from the start. When our paths cross, the escape will be complete."

\"L_Evna_02_19\".m_mContent: "But at the beginning, all is unknown. Are you truly so certain you'll place your trust in a stranger who approaches without cause?"

\"L_Evna_02_20\".m_mContent: "If one knew every step in advance, fear would smother resolve. Thus ignorance itself becomes my greatest weapon."

\"L_Evna_02_21\".m_mContent: "But here's the question—why should I trust a complete stranger?"

\"L_Evna_02_22\".m_mContent: "I can't convince a heart already clouded by doubt. I've offered you a solution—whether you take it is your choice."

\"L_Evna_02_23\".m_mContent: "I've walked this cycle countless times already. One more won't make a difference."

\"L_Evna_09_01\".m_mContent: "Blinding flames seared the air, forcing eyes shut. Slaves were driven into a grim procession, pushed into the fire as the acrid stench of burning flesh choked the air."

\"L_Evna_09_02\".m_mContent: "I never imagined your solution would be to walk into the flames once more."

\"L_Evna_09_03\".m_mContent: "From the moment I first chose you, I knew with absolute certainty—together, we would bring this tragedy to an end."

\"L_Evna_09_04\".m_mContent: "Just look at what we've achieved in mere days—so many impossibilities realized through our bond."

\"L_Evna_09_05\".m_mContent: "How did you discover that the Calamity could be reversed?"

\"L_Evna_09_06\".m_mContent: "Mass is the amalgamation of my will with the wills of all the enslaved after death. A spirit of wills should not exist in this world—yet since it does, there must be purpose in its existence."

\"L_Evna_09_07\".m_mContent: "I believe it persists because it carries a singular, unfulfilled obsession—to undo the tragedy that befell Carrelle."

\"L_Evna_09_08\".m_mContent: "If I hadn't experienced "Death" myself, I might never have believed such a possibility—"

\"L_Evna_09_09\".m_mContent: "Enduring endless suffering, reaching the very end of time, then wielding millennia of accumulated anguish as fuel to bend the laws of time and space and restore chaotic energy to order."

\"L_Evna_09_10\".m_mContent: "So we have both discovered the truth we sought through our encounter with the Calamity, have we not?"

\"L_Evna_09_11\".m_mContent: "Are you so certain you can find a path back from the end of time and space?"

\"L_Evna_09_12\".m_mContent: "You will remain here and guide me in knowing when to halt."

\"L_Evna_09_13\".m_mContent: "You're not worried I might abandon the board?"

\"L_Evna_09_15\".m_mContent: "I believe in you. Your will at this moment will act like gravity—drawing us back to the present."

\"L_Evna_09_16\".m_mContent: "So that's why you asked me to be your temporal anchor..."

\"L_Evna_09_17\".m_mContent: "Exactly. You carry the will of "Death" itself—strong enough to stand against "War" and serve as an anchor in the temporal currents."

\"L_Evna_09_18\".m_mContent: "Here. I want you to have this."

\"L_Evna_09_20\".m_mContent: "You who are about to endure such suffering must find this far harder to bear than I, merely waiting here."

\"L_Evna_09_21\".m_mContent: "This sword has been my companion through countless battles between life and death. I pray it will carve a path home for you and all the people of Carrelle."

\"L_Evna_09_23\".m_mContent: "This side of time—leave it to me."

\"L_Evna_09_24\".m_mContent: "Genevieve stepped into the sea of flames, and fire erupted in a streak of azure light—the color of her eyes, her final trace upon this world."

\"L_Evna_09_25\".m_mContent: "Then came the vigil—a waiting as vast as eternity itself. Year upon year, the Divine Body's flames guttered and blazed anew, blazed and guttered, beating like some cosmic heart."

\"L_Evna_09_26\".m_mContent: "None could say where Genevieve and her people had gone, what ordeals they had endured, or why Noah had kept his long watch over the forbidden grounds."

\"L_Evna_09_27\".m_mContent: "Until that day when Noah slowly lifted his gaze to the endless sea of eternal flame."

\"L_Evna_09_28\".m_mContent: "Why... why are the flames no longer burning?"

\"L_Evna_09_29\".m_mContent: "Noah reached into the sea of flames, yet there was no burning as he had expected. The temperature plummeted sharply until ice crystals formed across his fingertips."

\"L_Evna_09_31\".m_mContent: "Is that you, Genevieve? Have you restored order to the chaos?"

\"L_Evna_09_32\".m_mContent: "The flames gradually stilled, growing weaker and weaker until they were completely extinguished, leaving behind a charred crater—the ashes of the Calamity "War"."

\"L_Evna_09_33\".m_mContent: "You've vanquished the Calamity. Against all odds, you actually did it."

\"L_Evna_09_34\".m_mContent: "At the bottom of the crater, a familiar object lies shrouded in silence."

\"L_Evna_09_37\".m_mContent: "This reenactment of memory proves far more vivid and enduring than I had ever imagined..."

\"L_Evna_09_39\".m_mContent: "This is the dagger from my memories—the one that remained when the war ended. How did it end up here?"

\"L_Evna_09_40\".m_mContent: "It was always your sword. Time's power merely compressed it, reshaping it into a dagger."

\"L_Evna_09_41\".m_mContent: "All our will—mine and my people's—from when we defied time itself has been forged into it. Now we return it to you."

\"L_Evna_09_43\".m_mContent: "It bears the power of anti-entropy. Take it, and make your deepest wish reality."

\"L_Evna_09_45\".m_mContent: "I heard Agares speak of it... all sinners who defy the laws of Tempus are cast into that accursed realm—a temporal purgatory."

\"L_Evna_09_46\".m_mContent: "Having transgressed as I have, I fear that's where my path leads—"

\"L_Evna_09_48\".m_mContent: "Dangerous temporal criminals like myself rarely get assigned 'neighbors.'"

\"L_Evna_09_49\".m_mContent: "Even rarer still are those bold enough to strike up a conversation on their very first day behind bars."

\"L_Evna_09_50\".m_mContent: "You don't remember me, do you? Just as I suspected... those memories never carried over..."

\"L_Evna_09_51\".m_mContent: "Cut to the chase—what is it you want?"

\"L_Evna_09_52\".m_mContent: "My purpose is simple—I'm here to break you out of this place."

\"L_Evna_09_53\".m_mContent: "How refreshingly original. Please, do elaborate—what exactly is your grand escape plan?"

\"L_Julis_10_01\".m_mContent: "I wait among the ruins of that battlefield in my dreams. Now, this place has become a forest in full bloom."

\"L_Julis_10_02\".m_mContent: "The night wind sweeps through the trees. Before the cold reaches me, there's a deadly chill that feels almost hellish."

\"L_Julis_10_03\".m_mContent: "A metal spear drags across the sandy ground, emitting a low, resonant clang."

\"L_Julis_10_05\".m_mContent: "He lifts his spear, the tip pointing straight at my brow."

\"L_Julis_10_07\".m_mContent: "Why have you started killing again? Why target the innocent?"

\"L_Julis_10_08\".m_mContent: "Innocent? You think the bandits who slaughtered that village are innocent? The knight who betrayed his comrades?"

\"L_Julis_10_09\".m_mContent: "I understand they can't be forgiven, but that doesn't justify going on a killing spree."

\"L_Julis_10_11\".m_mContent: "Since you are not the king I have awaited, the blood upon my spear remains insufficient."

\"L_Julis_10_12\".m_mContent: "Then let us see if your spear can taste my blood."

\"L_Julis_10_13\".m_mContent: "Julius raises his spear and charges forward with fluid precision. No wasted motion, no hesitation."

\"L_Julis_10_15\".m_mContent: "Against his swift thrust, my legs feel leaden. Even pushing myself to the limit, I barely escape his opening strike."

\"L_Julis_10_16\".m_mContent: "Fortunately, he doesn't press his advantage with a second strike."

\"L_Julis_10_17\".m_mContent: "It's been centuries since anyone could dodge my attacks."

\"L_Julis_10_18\".m_mContent: "I learned this move from you. It's proof that we once fought side by side."

\"L_Julis_10_20\".m_mContent: "Just like the Wolfsbane growing in this forest, they too bear witness to that ancient battle."

\"L_Julis_10_21\".m_mContent: "They remember the blood that stained this earth and the warriors who fell."

\"L_Julis_10_23\".m_mContent: "These flowers were trampled and burned in the flames of war. They hate what war brings, yet they do not shrink from resistance."

\"L_Julis_10_24\".m_mContent: "They are merely flowers. They never have a choice."

\"L_Julis_10_25\".m_mContent: "We have both been shaped by ritual, born into circumstances beyond our choosing."

\"L_Julis_10_26\".m_mContent: "But you can choose to wield that power to defy fate."

\"L_Julis_10_27\".m_mContent: "Of course, if you still find yourself craving blood, you know where to find me."

\"L_Julis_10_28\".m_mContent: "If you seek a friendly duel, I'm at your disposal."

\"L_Julis_10_29\".m_mContent: "It seems I have awakened at the perfect moment. He shall be the one—"

\"L_Julis_10_30\".m_mContent: "The destined sovereign who will guide the Bloodborn toward their rebirth."

\"L_Julis_10_31\".m_mContent: "Heh... It's quite amusing watching little Noah encounter him."

\"L_Valora_10_01\".m_mContent: "The Bathory territory lay shrouded in midnight's profound silence, with only the gentle chorus of insects stirring within the woods."

\"L_Valora_10_02\".m_mContent: "A luminous moon presided over the night sky as Valora and I wandered the moonlit grounds of the Bathory."

\"L_Valora_10_03\".m_mContent: "The night held an unusual stillness. Perhaps unsettled by our venture beyond the castle walls, Valora remained silent all the way."

\"L_Valora_10_04\".m_mContent: "Only the soft murmur of forest insects and the rhythmic hoofbeats of Ludgard disturbed the tranquil air."

\"L_Valora_10_05\".m_mContent: "I never imagined Ludgard would be like this."

\"L_Valora_10_06\".m_mContent: "I broke the silence first, hoping to draw Valora's attention away."

\"L_Valora_10_07\".m_mContent: "Ordinary steeds are beneath me—and besides, none could have survived the centuries I've slumbered."

\"L_Valora_10_08\".m_mContent: "Winning her as an ally took considerable effort on my part."

\"L_Valora_10_09\".m_mContent: "Ludgard snorted at hearing its master and me discuss it."

\"L_Valora_10_13\".m_mContent: "What's it like, walking these Bathory lands again after so long?"

\"L_Valora_10_17\".m_mContent: "To avoid unwanted scrutiny, Bathory has deliberately left the lands surrounding the castle untouched."

\"L_Valora_10_18\".m_mContent: "No matter how many years drift by, this place remains frozen in time."

\"L_Valora_10_19\".m_mContent: "Save for the grass growing wilder and the ancient trees reaching ever skyward."

\"L_Valora_10_20\".m_mContent: "But... for me, there's something comforting in that constancy."

\"L_Valora_10_22\".m_mContent: "At the Observatory, I once said, 'All of this feels foreign to me; only the eternal stars above still whisper of home.'"

\"L_Valora_10_23\".m_mContent: "And now, there is one more thing that stirs recognition within me."

\"L_Valora_10_25\".m_mContent: "But... no matter how many echoes of the past I find, this world has become something else entirely."

\"L_Valora_10_26\".m_mContent: "Valora halted, her gaze drawn upward to the starlit tapestry above."

\"L_Valora_10_27\".m_mContent: "So much has transpired in the shadow of my slumber."

\"L_Valora_10_28\".m_mContent: "Baphomet's treacherous rise, Ganelon's fall from grace, even the young master in whom I placed such faith..."

\"L_Valora_10_30\".m_mContent: "A true knight transcends the crude brutality of mere weapon-wielding."

\"L_Valora_10_31\".m_mContent: "In the time since my awakening, I have come to understand the essence of the great upheavals that have swept across this continent."

\"L_Valora_10_34\".m_mContent: "Valora turned to face me directly, her gaze piercing through me with an overwhelming, suffocating presence."

\"L_Valora_10_35\".m_mContent: "I know you have become Bathory's new master."

\"L_Valora_10_36\".m_mContent: "I do not acknowledge you as my master. We may become companions, if you will it—but my loyalty is not yours to claim."

\"L_Valora_10_37\".m_mContent: "Loss and loneliness—for the first time, I glimpsed these shadows dwelling within Valora's heart."

\"L_Valora_10_38\".m_mContent: "...Yet perhaps this resolve of mine serves no purpose at all."

\"L_Valora_10_39\".m_mContent: "I have been sleeping through countless ages—so long that I am now but a forgotten name in history, dusty and neglected."

\"L_Valora_10_40\".m_mContent: "In quiet moments, I find myself questioning whether this new age has any need for my vigil."

\"L_Valora_10_41\".m_mContent: "Lady Empousa granted you life. In some way, you might barely qualify as heir to the Bathory."

\"L_Valora_10_44\".m_mContent: "Valora never imagined I would be against her."

\"L_Valora_10_45\".m_mContent: "Indeed, I am the new master of Bathory, and I too bear the Bathory bloodline you cherish so deeply."

\"L_Valora_10_46\".m_mContent: "But you don't have to acknowledge me."

\"L_Valora_10_47\".m_mContent: "After your long slumber, you feel lost when facing the current world"

\"L_Valora_10_48\".m_mContent: "I've felt that emptiness too—when your past is nothing but a void."

\"L_Valora_10_49\".m_mContent: "You don't need to force yourself into this new world. Just hold fast to your principles—to the way of the knight."

\"L_Valora_10_50\".m_mContent: "Choose your own world, rather than letting the world choose you."

\"L_Valora_10_51\".m_mContent: "Well, as a relic of the old world, I'm honored that you still see the gold in me."

\"L_Valora_10_54\".m_mContent: "Prove yourself worthy of the Bathory name, and you'll have my loyalty."

\"L_Valora_10_56\".m_mContent: "Valora approached Ludgard and swung herself into the saddle."

\"L_Valora_10_57\".m_mContent: "I noticed the metal saddle I had retrieved for her was already secured in place."

\"L_Valora_10_59\".m_mContent: "But perhaps we should start by having you mount Ludgard."

\"L_Valora_10_60\".m_mContent: "At its master's command, Ludgard broke into a run."

\"L_Valora_10_61\".m_mContent: "I could almost see them thundering across the battlefield."
